We have an excellent chance to FLIP seven seats in this coming election. We only need to take TWO to take the Majority. Let’s take all seven and build a Majority that holds for a decade. | **West Virginia**
**Montana**

It has been a long time since we’ve had a chance like this, Peter.

**We can take back the majority and build one so strong it stands for ten years or longer!** Can you imagine that? Ten years of Republicans running the Senate and accomplishing incredible things.

[**These seven seats are CRITICAL for our efforts. If we fail and don’t flip at least two of these seats, we could be doomed to ten years of a Democrat Majority in the U.S. Senate.**](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=83448034aa764cce8728dec0bf78de09&_e=OBW3yZ7ucQs66PB2HxZmKQ1aiDLvxjesdlOMvJFIIHl79r9b735-obelnVsE41y8YAdrGYRDrS9VydICvHlfN1V3JuJ5EWlk1C_x30keayBhmN8cuGoq3oluGizID68LG6CtZWJVl1nx44fk62kUNKSY1f6FBa5wV-k9WyH9VcqLWEr8e0SbgUGu6y1YLKE7dOAFxY-W6ZM82eQAYHxm6FuEVFAgGxIDF71BEKu2VReHFavlhk9jlbuiC4-qu1w1UKaNXQdVdwxULITHKXbWaz8ajHMEFIFpFUI8yooY7wSLiiVR1is0dyInqk4M4KU6Y6DWSWeIsgq6cn13jORbJuZ5t-FMLs7MurG08q30h1zqt89YLjN-Z9sjJJVOkXY1BtDRMR0CUKTrtsOjRrcYFdNYV-qQdIgn4DGvRRkmh-M%3D)

That would be a horrible development. We have seen what Democrats do with power in the last four years, and we can’t risk more of their failed ideas and dangerous agenda. Our country’s future is on the line.

Future generations are counting on us to stand up to their insanity NOW before we are living in a country decimated by open borders amnesty, barely scraping by as inflation rises to astronomical proportions, our 2nd amendment rights are in tatters, and our military is weakened by Democrats refusing to raise our troops pay.

* I’m one of just eleven (out of 435!) Members of Congress who don't take federal lobbyist money.

body:
While one donation may not seem like a lot, the collective power of thousands of donations drives our movement forward. You can play a pivotal role in electing state Dems nationwide by donating today. | | |
---
| |
---|---
**$7.** That’s all we’re asking for to help elect Democrats in the states. Here’s why: **Reason #1:** There are _seven_ special elections this month in states like Alabama, Kentucky, and New Hampshire – $7 helps win races like those and more. **Reason #2:** We’re battling Republican mega-donors who are dumping millions into races nationwide. body:
I wanted to cut through the noise and write to you today
Derek, with just two days until the primary election, I want to cut through the noise and explain where things stand in this race.
Last week two new polls dropped. The first, showed us in third place, behind Republican Steve Garvey by six points. **The second, conducted later when voters had more time to see our ads, showed us one point ahead of Garvey and in second place.** These polls also show that large margins of voters—nearly 20% are still undecided about who to support.
So while this forward movement is a promising sign, Schiff saw the exact same poll. He has been spending millions of dollars to try and *boost* Garvey into the second place spot so that he has an easy-to-defeat general election opponent.
**Both Schiff and his super PAC are spending heavily on Fox News to propel Garvey into second place, despite Schiff’s previous calls for advertisers to boycott the network.**

Hi Derek, this
is Eve, Adam’s wife.

You might not know this, but Adam and I first met on a tennis court in
Playa del Rey, when a mutual friend arranged some doubles.

He almost didn’t show up (he was late)... and if he wanted to win a tennis
match, then he should have stayed home (I smoked him 💪).

But luckily enough for both of us, he’s been my favorite tennis partner
ever since.

That’s how we became Adam and Eve, and although we didn’t meet in the
Garden of Eden, our 29 years of marriage have been pretty incredible.

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=mar2024_abs_em.YceVvx&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_GEN_AC90_20240303_PM2_V1_S1&t=1004&akid=5858%2E5257348%2ExaSYkO ]Adam and Eve giggling candidly

Adam is an amazing husband and father.

And we’ve had some thrilling adventures together. Not all of them have
been easy. But from the campaigns he lost to the sweet campaign victories,
from his travels across the district for his congressional races to his
statewide travels across California, our relationship has been a busy,
fulfilling, and exciting journey.

There are times it has been tough — I’ll admit, it’s hard to hear all the
attacks and insults the former president and his cronies throw Adam’s way.

But Adam is relentless in defending our democracy. Protecting the rule of
law. Building an economy that works for everyone.

Now that this Senate primary is just a few short days away, Adam is facing
one of his biggest challenges yet.

I know he can take it on — he’ll face any challenge just the way he does
when he’s on the tennis court. He’ll stretch, lace up his sneakers, and be
ready for whatever comes his way.

Game, set, and match — Super Tuesday is just two days away!

I am the son of a pastor and eldest of 10 siblings, growing up on a farm in Western Maryland... | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/coxforcongress/forgotten-no-more?e=5bb5efcda7)

| |
# The Forgotten Man & Woman No More.

,
What built America was hard work, determination, independence, family and friends, and a trust in God. And a spirit of never giving up.

I am the son of a pastor and eldest of 10 siblings, growing up on a farm in Western Maryland and working at times $3.00/hour to fill hay barns for area farmers, or rise at 4:30am in the summer to milk dairy cows and feed horses, sheep and beef.

_One of the champion lambs I raised and marketed with my Shropshire Lamb business, selling to local grocery stores in Frederick. (c) Dan Cox, 2024. All rights reserved._

My dad's father from Wichita was the first in his family to graduate from college, which he did on the GI Bill, after flying fighter planes at the end of WWII. He kindly hand-signed this photograph for me just two months before he died. In his career, he had worked up the ladder and "pulled himself up by his own bootstraps" to be a CFO accountant for various major companies including what was Peat Marwick Int'l here in Maryland (now KPMG).

_Lt. Dick Cox, circa 1945. (c) Dan Cox, 2024. All rights reserved._

Growing up in rural Maryland, we were rich in eternal things that last. My parents always made life so exciting and Christmas was always a joyful time where we all were thankful for the gifts and necessities we received.

_Replacing the roof on our 200 year old Maryland farmhouse with my dad and our friends.
Circa 1989. (c) Dan Cox, 2024. All rights reserved._

Our family recently watched the opening 1.5 hours of the American Classic, Little House on the Prairie, and I was once again struck by one scene. After over a year of hard labor building an entire farm with their own hands from right off the Kansas land which the U.S. government had promised to them as part of its settlement of the West, the United States government federal officers then rode up and issued orders for them to leave and relocate - they were confiscating their land and buildings as part of a changed boundary line deal back in Washington.

Poignantly just then, Charles "Pa" Ingalls (Michael Landon) says to his wife Caroline (Karen Grassle), "those blasted politicians back in Washington..."

**The "blasted politicians" in DC today are no different - in fact they're worse.**

Like President Trump, as your Member of Congress I will bring to the DC table the voice of the Forgotten Man & Woman. No more will we be forgotten - but our voices will be heard and action taken to do what we as elected leaders are required to do to help those we represent.

That means at a minimum:
* **DEMANDING** reduction of taxes and regulations on Maryland employees and businesses so we can stay, live and retire in our beautiful state. I am the only candidate who has pledged to not vote for continuing resolutions and out of control budgets and I will vote to stop giving our taxpayer money to Ukraine and foreign wars.
* **SEAL THE BORDER NOW** , reinstate Title 42 & 8 deportations, remain in Mexico policy, ending catch & release, ending asylum fraud and restarting speedy deportations by ICE.
* **ENDING CORRUPTION** , securing our elections and rooting out corrupt officials.

Western Maryland needs a strong, unbending and sure elected Member of Congress, or we will continue to be forgotten.

I will stand for you. I understand what it's like to struggle to make ends meet, and to triumph through hard and determined work. I worked three jobs to put myself through college at Mt. St. Mary's and the University of Maryland, and then law school - married with four children. We did it to stand up for the forgotten man and woman - to stand up for our great nation and our beautiful Flag and most importantly, our Constitution.

We must never give up. This is our land. This is our country. Thank you for helping me win for all of us.

Voting begins by mail on April 1st - in just 28 days - for the primary which is scheduled for in-person on May 14. Can you believe that? 44 days of voting - instead of the one day our Constitution mandates.

Help me reach the voters today so that none of us are forgotten. Just $100 reaches about 367 voters, but any amount will help.

Thanks and God bless the working man and woman and all our fellow Americans.

Freedom and Victory,
[](https://coxforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=866897dcd900340c866a1068a&id=daadcd71db&e=5bb5efcda7)
Dan Cox, Candidate for Congress (R-MD6)
[](https://coxforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=866897dcd900340c866a1068a&id=5abefc9c5b&e=5bb5efcda7)
P.S. In the next 28 days I need to reach 100,000 voters. If you can also help me with a sign location or a house meet and greet with a minimum of 20 guests, please go on my website and fill out the form and someone from the campaign will be in touch.

body:
Adam Schiff in the Senate would be a nightmare for the USA. We can’t let this radical socialist win in California, pulling the Senate left with his victory. | Peter,

We can't sit on the sidelines for this one. The implications are far too important. Adam Schiff, one of the most radical, liberal members of the House of Representatives, is running for U.S. Senate in California. His campaign thus far has seemed more like a pamphlet for a radical socialist college activist group than a campaign for Congress.

We can't let Adam win. His policies are wrong for America and will take our country backward. We've heard all these bad socialist ideas before, but they usually come from a college professor, not a member of Congress.

_**In the Senate, Adam Schiff would:** _

**Abolish the filibuster.**
**Raise taxes by $6 trillion.**
**Make D.C. a state.**
**Rewrite U.S. election law.**
**Expand the Supreme Court.**
Adam Schiff's agenda looks like the wish list of a campus radical. If these things come true, it will be a dark day for America.

---
| **March 3, 2024**
# **SUNDAY NEWS DIGEST**
### By Heidi Ganahl
---
| Good evening, The legislative session in Colorado is already bustling with the introduction of 523 bills, including both promising and contentious ones. We loved this breakdown of [good vs. bad bills this legislative session](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) by Kevin Lundberg in his weekly newsletter, [The Lundberg Report. ](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) **Good Bills Highlights:**
* HB24-1022: This bill requires bill drafts to be published online before the session, enhancing transparency.
* HB24-1023: Addressing civil forfeiture reform, this bill aims to rectify a system in need of reform.
* HB24-1065: Proposing a reduction of the state income tax rate, though it faces challenges.
* HB24-1142: Seeking to reduce income tax on social security benefits, offering potential relief.
* HB24-1166: Aiming to expand homestead exemptions, providing additional property tax relief.

**Bad Bills Highlights:**
* HB24-1014: Raises concerns about deceptive trade practices, potentially leading to increased lawsuits.
* HB24-1028: Reviving discussions on overdose prevention centers, sparking controversy.
* HB24-1039: Touching on non-legal name changes, potentially impacting parental involvement in schooling.
* HB24-1057: Targets landlords with regulations on rent-setting algorithms, viewed as unnecessary government intervention.
* SB24-053: Initiating a racial equity study, signaling the beginning of discussions around reparations.
* SB24-159: Proposing modifications to energy and carbon management, with potential consequences for the oil and gas industry.

There have been several different bills introduced to disarm Coloradans in just the first month of the Legislative Session. Today, there are a total of seven different Democrat-backed bills aimed at your gun rights. **Two More Anti-Second Amendment Bills:**
* HB24-1348 - Secure Firearm Storage in a Vehicle: If passed, firearms stored in unattended vehicles will be required to be kept in a locked, hard-sided container and kept out of view or locked in the trunk of the vehicle. Civil penalties for infractions can reach up to $500.
* HB24-1349 - Firearms & Ammunition Excise Tax: This bill seeks to add an 11% excise tax to the purchase of all firearms, firearm accessories, and ammunition in Colorado. Firearms and ammunition are already taxed at an 11% rate through the Pittman-Robertson Act, in addition to a variety of other state and local taxes. Since this is a tax increase, passage of this bill in the Legislature will automatically place the question on your ballot this November thanks to TABOR.

Stay informed, stay engaged, and make your voice heard! Make sure to [message or call your legislators](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) to tell them how you feel about these bills. Have a great week, Heidi Ganahl
---

# FEATURED

[**Only 22% of Coloradans have voted in Presidential primary, with 5% more voting GOP over Democrat ballot**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) By Brian Porter, Rocky Mountain Voice Editor & Publisher
| [ ](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
---
Of those Coloradans eligible to cast a ballot in the Republican Party’s presidential primary election, only 15.3% have done so, according to data provided Friday by the Colorado secretary of state’s office through the close of Thursday’s reporting. It leads those eligible to cast a Democratic Party ballot and having done so by 4.9%. It has been slow going thus far, with just short of 22% of all voters casting a ballot, and with women leading men in ballots cast. With 108,200 ballots in process Friday and with Election Day looming on Tuesday, March 5, it could be a low turnout for voters to weigh in on their choice for U.S. President. The presumptive national party nominees are Democrat Joe Biden and Republican Donald Trump, with neither having lost a primary election entering Super Tuesday.
| [ READ MORE ](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)

# STATE
**[Colorado Senate panel rejects Gov. Jared Polis’ nominees to wildlife commission](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [COLORADO POLITICS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) Last year, Gov. Jared Polis appointed three people — allegedly with ties to the animal rights community — to the state's parks and wildlife commission. But those nominees still had to go through a confirmation process with the state Senate, and on Thursday, the Senate Agriculture and Natural Resources Committee rejected two of the three, claiming they lacked the necessary qualifications to represent the constituents tied to those seats and as required by state law.
[**WATCH: Colorado Democrats unveil portrait of Joe Biden, paid for by Joe taxpayer**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) [COLORADO POLITICS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) Colorado Democrats unveiled the state’s portrait of President Joe Biden in a ceremony Friday at the state Capitol. Biden’s portrait will be displayed, along with his 45 predecessors in the state Capitol’s third floor Presidential Portrait Gallery.
[**Colorado lawmakers discuss funding AI software to detect guns in schools**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) [COLORADO POLITICS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) A proposal seeks to prevent shootings by providing schools with funding to acquire, install and operate AI-driven software that — the company behind the technology claims — can detect guns and alert law enforcement within seconds of the weapon’s detection.

# Take your Health Back!
Alright, everybody, strap in because I've got something absolutely mind-blowing to share with you, especially all my folks in California and the surrounding areas. This is not your average health benefit – we're talking about a game-changer!
Now, I've been through the wringer when it comes to health. Yeah, I shed a whopping 500 pounds recently, but guess what? The battle's far from over. My body's still screaming in pain, and I'm staring down the barrel of two knee replacements. Back and hips? They're on a constant pain playlist, and the list of issues just keeps growing.
So, what do you do when the traditional pharmaceutical game doesn't cut it? You dig deep, you research, and you look for alternatives. And let me tell you, my skepticism led me to a revelation that's going to blow your minds!
About a month back, my buddy of 20 years, Pastor James Fortune, hit me up with news that changed the game for him and his wife, Canada. They discovered a treatment so good, it sounds too good to be true. But hold on – it's legit! We're talking medical documents, x-rays, blood tests – the whole nine yards.
I practically dragged Pastor James Fortune to Los Angeles because I knew you needed to hear this. We're hosting him at not one, but two locations in LA County. Picture this: an amazing catered dinner on us, and all the info you need to make educated decisions about taking charge of your health and living your absolute best life right now.
Don't procrastinate until your body breaks down even more. It's time to restore your youth, break free from the pain, and live the life you've been dreaming of. This is your shot, my friends – seize it!

| | | Recently, there was a panel discussion called “Adam Schiff Justice” at the Conservative Political Action Conference (known as CPAC). And trust me, it was not designed to be a flattering reference. Then, MAGA House Republican leader Elise Stefanik spent her speaking time at CPAC attacking me. She called me a “Russia hoaxer” and denied the January 6th insurrection. And only a few hours later, Donald Trump took the stage at a campaign rally in South Carolina, where he once again lashed out at me. He called me a “sleazebag” for investigating his blackmail threat to bribe Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy to dig up dirt on Joe Biden. And more. All of this happened in one day. With only a few hours until our primary election, we can only expect more attacks from here. And while we’re spending our campaign resources on reaching voters, we also need to be able to respond to these outrageous attacks against me. [Will you rush an urgent split contribution of $10 or any amount between Blue Amp Action and my campaign to help us fight back against Trump and his MAGA cronies?](https://default.salsalabs.org/T19ccd5a3-6992-4db6-b0aa-e5e943225646/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

| | | About BlueAmp Action: We cannot sugarcoat the current situation. Right-wing authoritarianism, defeated by a worldwide coalition during WWII, was only in hibernation. Over the past decade it has infected democratic societies--including ours. It is as simple as it is terrifying: What we do now will define the future of our country and world. We at Blue Amp Action are dedicated to liberal, open societies, where reason and science are applied to solve our problems; where civil rights--including voting rights!--are protected for all. We fight for these values every day. Speaking up on our platforms, raising the voices and the political prospects of liberal pols and pundits. **And savvy grassroots activists like you know, just like we do, that we can’t stop watching the people we help elect:_ after the elections, we have to keep organizing support for the policies we like and pushing back against the ones we don’t._** **__When the public tunes out between elections and the only people our elected officials hear from are the paid lobbyists of wealthy corporations, our government stops being accountable to the needs of ordinary families.__** **Democracy never sleeps, and neither can we.** So we ask that you support our work, so we can continue to engage in this fight every moment of every day. So our kids grow up in democracy, not dystopia. Thank you for your support for all we do! Please follow Cliff Schecter on Twitter @cliffschecter, or subscribe to The Takedown with Cliff Schecter on YouTube, to keep up to date with this battle for the heart and soul of our country. — _You're getting this message because you’ve supported good causes and Democratic candidates. We need your support to continue fighting for our democracy. body:

Dear
Friend,
Over the
last century, free-market capitalism and socialism have provided
the dominant interpretations, and conflicting visions, of
political and economic freedom. In the past few years, we've seen
a growing trend among young Americans in favor of socialism and
against capitalism.

But do
they truly understand the history and outcomes of socialism and
capitalism?

This is
precisely why we put together this brand new eBook, The History
Of Socialism And Capitalism, from Hoover Institution senior
fellows Niall Ferguson and Victor Davis Hanson.

This
eBook consists of two papers-one from each scholar-written in
conjunction with The Human Prosperity Project on Socialism and
Free-Market Capitalism. This project provides objective and
scholarly analyses of free-market capitalism, socialism, and
hybrid systems and provides evidence on the effectiveness of the
various systems on outcomes that affect prosperity and
well-being.

I think
you will find this new eBook particularly important and timely,
given the recent interest in policies that are radical from a US
historical perspective, some of which are advocated by political
leaders.

Simply
click here to request your free copy of The History Of Socialism
And Capitalism.

Thanks,
Greg

Greg
Stamps | Online Development
Hoover
Institution | Stanford University

With its
eminent scholars and world-renowned Library and Archives, the
Hoover Institution is a non-partisan, data-driven policy research
organization that seeks to improve the human condition by
advancing ideas that promote economic prosperity, national
security, and democratic governance. Over more than one hundred
years, Hoover's work has directly led to policies that have
produced greater freedom, democracy, and opportunity in the
United States and around the world.

This project provides objective and scholarly analyses of free-market capitalism, socialism, and hybrid systems and provides evidence on the effectiveness of the various systems on outcomes that affect prosperity and well-being. I think you will find this new eBook particularly important and timely, given the recent interest in policies that are radical from a US historical perspective, some of which are advocated by political leaders. ## Illegal Immigration Surges
Over eight million illegal immigrants will be living inside the United States by September, according to government estimates [obtained by ](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskL9utDAQxJ_GdEb2-h8uXHwN3X1tSrSHl7uNAJ-MdSRvH5E6zWj0G2k0mo_bdENeeX_8x41SW8qEc-M3TUZaCXayXU4LEZDpKOmgovMQQ-yeyc9DMDmSxeCUB1ROD06bwSB6HWLoOIECq4yyWjmvXR8W67LXRPcYXbZRWEWZW6n9Z-G9PWlZv8ubaj-XrVvTs7XXIcw_AaOA8TzPHr-4HFcqYLy6BYzKXAICxowN5Z0z7fJeaqYq58oHH5K3jR8VG5ddDnLjdb1cpkb7xbqa8uu86OGDsOqxIa-_E9pff_wEAAD__zbKYAc)_[Axios](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskL9utDAQxJ_GdEb2-h8uXHwN3X1tSrSHl7uNAJ-MdSRvH5E6zWj0G2k0mo_bdENeeX_8x41SW8qEc-M3TUZaCXayXU4LEZDpKOmgovMQQ-yeyc9DMDmSxeCUB1ROD06bwSB6HWLoOIECq4yyWjmvXR8W67LXRPcYXbZRWEWZW6n9Z-G9PWlZv8ubaj-XrVvTs7XXIcw_AaOA8TzPHr-4HFcqYLy6BYzKXAICxowN5Z0z7fJeaqYq58oHH5K3jR8VG5ddDnLjdb1cpkb7xbqa8uu86OGDsOqxIa-_E9pff_wEAAD__zbKYAc). _ That's up from six million last September and only three million in 2019--an increase of 167% in the last five years. Texas has dominated border headlines in the last month, but it isn't the only state dealing with border security issues. Border Patrol officials have reported a [sharp increase](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLFurDAQAL_GdEa2Wcy5cPEaunttSmRg99jI4JPtg-TvoyRt6hlppHm7T_fAkY_H_7Cjr5SmsFQ-ceokSAMTNKsnRINdg14PyvXWuME1m-8tWbDWuBvNQGGwaoDuRnPQ2mqkuWFvlAHVKdCqt7pvB4J-tRpxdq5fwQlQuHJNuX1PfNQNKX6mE3O7pL2Jfqv1WUT3T5hRmPG6rpbSx4FX-ebCjM8UufJShBnnlFfMMhHxwiEWWRDlHkrhE-WBlyyv_EBZ0qtumA_56zfZr8-LY-RiBwHqsQeOP_H614mvAAAA___4r2Hf) in encounters near Tuscon, Arizona, last weekend--14,000 on Friday and Saturday alone.
## Extreme Blizzard in California
70 mph winds and 5-7 feet of snowfall [battered parts of the Sierra Nevada region](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LGOrCAUgOGnwQ6DcJChoLiN3dx2S3OUw8AGZYLsGOfpN7v11n_xJ9_Hfb5jyml__MeNXAtlxrWlF82KA5cwQ-ddIJKkOnKDEVaP0hrbRWeWW7AWUASJBlHDYozVfr3ZZbDBQpecFBKEEjAIPQ66NwG0HweixVrtwTIQ5FMrtf8saW-RQr7Ki2q_lq3LLrb2PJj6x-TE5HSeZ39hLOWnMjntdB5MTktO7zdWz59f20b54HupLVLd-Yo5hVL3hDwSvi4upQIlYFR9bFvuqvPPM-WcjtEwEI8NU_49t78YvgMAAP__oG1fHw) in California over the weekend. The storm shut down ski resorts, closed roads, and even activated a rare blizzard warning in Sacramento. Thousands were left without power and had to [dig their way out](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsjzFv8yAUAH8NbLHg8cBhYPikT97SjpW6WNg8DC0OkUNs5d9X6dz1TjrpPi7jxeeSr8ubX8m1WEc_t7zTqE54AhyRBxeJgBQnJ3thtQHbW55cT9oonLQSYTaojT2DN3LCCB6iFTPPDgSgUAKl0Ebqro-og5FEk7U6oGUoKORWt-6r5mtLFMuz7rR1c115cam1252pfwwGBsNxHN2zPtpjopd_Ed_mxNSwM_X_LOTyTp8q4TffXLgduZR8Nz1Dsaw-l99k--vvJwAA__9KW0-s) of snow-packed homes and driveways. Near Lake Tahoe, gusts of wind were [measured at 190 mph](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskL2O2zAQhJ-G6iRQy7-oUJGGndOmFFbm0t6AJg2StmA_feADrrtmphlgPnx_T9sJOXG-_MEbrT2WDc-dn7SpUY-gNz2ENRIBqYHW2cnFWFjcMlxXZUjuYVYabHSRrJM7YjB6j2jtPuuBV5CgpZJ6lsbOZnJRm2Bnon1ZTNCL0JIC91Knf4Vzv1JMr_KkOp3LbUjrtfd7E-q3AC_AH8cxPRr2EvD1GQjwrZf6EuAzHe1T2LlkAf5zK8BL9R174vcbaxjv5ZFDG8-YOJaaGcfGVCuOmZ4YUIB38EvJ2YCUToAf6hruB6fEzTqh5eWGnL7w-k-u_gcAAP__TNxomQ)--well above the threshold for a category five hurricane. Authorities are calling the storm an "extreme blizzard," and many trucks and cars became [stuck in the snow](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsj7Fu6zAMAL9G2hJINCWFg4a3eMtbOxqyRccs5Diw2QT9-wLN2vFww-E-rsO1SJP77X9ZOeu8DWVSefLQnfAEOKCteWYG7ixnnxyFCJTILpnKeGEOBeYAMY0XAOe54jSlErAGspLBAbrOoXch-nBOM4YaPfNIFCqSQcdVdNvPn5vcdeG5fW9P3s_TttqWF9XHYbp_BnoDvb5E9e0M9KtMS-F28BsPLfp1GOh9ioiIKSBSJIieot1zfbykNTliMuhua5H2m9C_fn8CAAD__7t0VF0) on the freeway between Colfax and Reno.
## Map: Median Down Payments in America
The median down payment for a single-family home varies widely from state to state, as shown by [this map](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0DGPtCAQgOFfgx0GEfGjoPgau732SjPCsM4FxcjsGv_95a6-_k3e5Pl8zA-gTPvzAzb0nMoMgemNcy-N1GY2TfQJUWPfoO9G5Qar3eia1cd_vQ1LCMEuMXVqdNYqGK2NqEGnAA15rbRRvTKdGmw3tGMyQ7Qd4uLcEI0TRmEkLmf7VWjnFVO-yxvPNpStyX5lPqro_ws9CT1d19W-qb4gBziIIVPln1DoKRxCTxtGgl3Gcu3ygHvDnWUqpwS5lldFudyyMjAKPTWnj8dFOVO1ozDquQHl3yn_JfAdAAD__3WZXqI) displaying data from realtor.com. Hawaii, Florida, and Washington, D.C. are tied for the top spot with an average of $98,700, and Mississippi is the most affordable with an average of just $5,800. If you're an Ohio Trump supporter, don't skip the March 19th Republican Primary. While President Trump's nomination is secure, there's still crucial work to do. We need your vote to secure Senate control, gain House seats, support local conservatives, and defeat the Ohio "Blue 22". MOST IMPORTANTLY Democrats may try to sway the primary to weaken our candidates by pulling a Republican primary ballot and "crossing over" to steal our votes! Your vote ensures we elect strong Republicans who will advance the "Trump Agenda". Spread the word and vote on March 19th (or any time February 21 or after using absentee or early-voting options). Check out our recommended candidates at **[LiberatorList.com](https://gfiohio.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c2cee5a5358289d5dd20ff17d&id=c42472f74b&e=5c740fa3e2)**. _**We need people to step-up to lead some of the workgroups.**_ In some cases to take the load off those who are stretched too thin, who have far too much on their plates. In others we need a leader to form a brand new workgroup team.

**We need leaders for:**
* **Social Media Team**

* **Church & Pastor Database Team**

* **Candidate Recruiting Team**
* **Comprehensive Candidate "Toolkit" Team**

These are volunteer positions but we do have a small budget for your use.

**If you are interested in discussing the possibility of leading one of these teams, please text or call Mark Pukita at 614-499-0599.**

Thank you!

body:
The Democrat "machine" is hitting me with everything they've got

| | | [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c695047%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=HX5P5oUeCih%2b6IspuimKXg&sysid=1)

Friend, **[**There is less than a week before the March 5th primary and I need your support to help me beat Adam Schiff and Katie Porter.**](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c695048%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=j2OT1Ii6n5Hn1%2bqBPT%2fPAw&sysid=1)** The Democrat "machine" is hitting me with everything they've got in a last-ditch effort to ensure that two Democrats advance to November - thus cementing their grip on this seat and denying Californians the real choice we deserve. You and I cannot let them get away with this. The top two vote getters on March 5th will advance to November. So, your support is absolutely critical to help me keep building the momentum needed to beat Adam Schiff and Katie Porter first in the primary and then again in November. **[That why I’m humbly asking you to rush and emergency $30 contribution to my campaign today.](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c695049%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=txny2IeEyJeGo3zykEk4ig&sysid=1)** There is less than a week until the primary election. That’s it. Then, after that, you and I will have just eight months to build a 58-county, grassroots campaign capable of defeating Adam Schiff - with his _ActBlue_ allies and the war chest he's assembled during the two decades he spent in Washington, DC. There’s no time to lose. With every day that goes by, you and I are getting more and more reminders why it’s so important we win this election. The reality is present-day America is starting to look a lot like 1970s America. You remember what it was like:
---
| |
* Not only were gas prices sky high, Carter's rationing meant we could only buy gas on even or odd days depending on our license plate numbers. Remember?

* Eleven Israeli athletes were slaughtered at the Olympic Village in Munich by terrorists. Remember?

* Fifty-two Americans were held hostage for 444 days by terrorists in Iran. Remember??

---
| | Democrat policies had brought America to its knees. And now, as Yogi Berra used to say, **_"It's deja vu all over again."_** Joe Biden, Adam Schiff and the rest of the Democrats don't care one bit that Americans are having a hard time. I'd go even further to say they welcome the misery so they can keep folks down and dependent. You and I _must_ win this race. **[That’s why I’m humbly asking you to rush your $30 donation to my campaign today to give me the boost I need to win in the primary.](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c695040%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=%2f7qj8nTbXIL0jyTRuz%2b9Nw&sysid=1)** Time is the most important factor. Like I mentioned, we've got less than a week until the primary. With your help, I'm confident we'll clear this hurdle and then it's on to November. Sincerely,
---
| |
---
Steve Garvey #6

subject: "On Message" From Michael B. Moore
body:
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP50/1/104585/images/Logo_white_rectangle.jpg]
On Message
from Michael B. Moore
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/michael.b.moore-sc.1st-newsletter [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/michael.b.moore-sc.1st-newsletter]
Welcome to our campaign newsletter.
We're happy you're here.
We'll use this space to keep you updated on all the latest stories, events and opportunities related to Michael's run for South Carolina's 1st congressional district.
Stay tuned — we'll be in your inbox every Monday.
See you on the trail.
Join our movement [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/michael.b.moore-sc.1st-newsletter]
In the news
https://www.politico.com/news/2023/07/25/dems-house-majority-the-south-00107401 [https://www.politico.com/news/2023/07/25/dems-house-majority-the-south-00107401]
POLITICO [https://www.politico.com/news/2023/07/25/dems-house-majority-the-south-00107401]
The national media is paying more and more attention to our race every day. Last week, POLITICO [https://www.politico.com/news/2023/07/25/dems-house-majority-the-south-00107401] reported that Democrats "are entertaining a once-unlikely prospect: retaking the House majority by winning in the South."
The story specifically highlighted the SC-01 racial gerrymandering case that will soon come before the Supreme Court [https://www.dailykos.com/stories/2023/7/17/2181780/-My-swing-district-has-its-date-before-the-Supreme-Court] .
Per POLITICO: "It's impossible to know how many seats could become competitive, but the party is hoping a handful may come into play and that new maps could even threaten the likes of ... Nancy Mace."
https://rollcall.com/2023/07/25/many-redistricting-redos-pending-but-24-election-outlook-unclear/ [https://rollcall.com/2023/07/25/many-redistricting-redos-pending-but-24-election-outlook-unclear/]
Roll Call [https://rollcall.com/2023/07/25/many-redistricting-redos-pending-but-24-election-outlook-unclear/]
Roll Call [https://rollcall.com/2023/07/25/many-redistricting-redos-pending-but-24-election-outlook-unclear/] ran a story explaining how new congressional maps "could be drawn in time to change the electoral landscape in 2024, when Democrats need a net gain of just five seats to take control of the House."
According to Roll Call, the SC-01 Supreme Court case "may also impact the federal redistricting litigation in Florida, which involves similar racial gerrymandering claims."
https://charlestoncitypaper.com/2023/07/21/our-view-high-court-should-force-remapping-effort/ [https://charlestoncitypaper.com/2023/07/21/our-view-high-court-should-force-remapping-effort/]
Charleston City Paper [https://charlestoncitypaper.com/2023/07/21/our-view-high-court-should-force-remapping-effort/]
And back home in the Lowcountry, the Charleston City Paper [https://charlestoncitypaper.com/2023/07/21/our-view-high-court-should-force-remapping-effort/] published an editorial calling on the Supreme Court to redraw the lines of SC-01 — so that the map "reflects the true electoral nature of our lower coast, not a district that the GOP bleached by moving thousands of Black voters to other districts."
On the picket line
https://www.dailykos.com/stories/2023/7/25/2183281/-Why-won-t-Nancy-Mace-stand-up-for-these-striking-Waffle-House-workers [https://www.dailykos.com/stories/2023/7/25/2183281/-Why-won-t-Nancy-Mace-stand-up-for-these-striking-Waffle-House-workers]
Union of Southern Service Workers [https://ussw.org/]
Michael expressed solidarity with the workers of the Waffle House on Garners Ferry Road in Columbia, South Carolina, who began a three-day strike [https://twitter.com/RaiseUptheSouth/status/1677737443145949184] on this month after delivering to management their petition to organize.
As a business executive with nearly four decades of private sector experience — including several years as a leader in South Carolina's food industry — Michael knows firsthand that employees throughout any organization deserve fair pay and safe working conditions.
https://holycitysinner.com/2023/07/22/moore-shows-support-for-striking-waffle-house-workers/ [https://holycitysinner.com/2023/07/22/moore-shows-support-for-striking-waffle-house-workers/]
Holy City Sinner [https://holycitysinner.com/2023/07/22/moore-shows-support-for-striking-waffle-house-workers/]
Michael steadfastly stands behind the striking Waffle House staff as they seek sensible concessions from management and strive for a better quality of life for restaurant workers in South Carolina.
He also urged Nancy Mace — who often mentions her past experience as a Waffle House waitress [https://twitter.com/NancyMace/status/1451926458994151427?ref_src=twsrc%5Etfw%7Ctwcamp%5Etweetembed%7Ctwterm%5E1451926458994151427%7Ctwgr%5Eb80d1ca7caee292360b8edb17aecebf62c52def8%7Ctwcon%5Es1_&ref_url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.dailykos.com%2Fstories%2F2023%2F7%2F25%2F2183281%2F-Why-won-t-Nancy-Mace-stand-up-for-these-striking-Waffle-House-workers] on the campaign trail — to similarly endorse the demands of those on strike.
In the arena
https://www.politico.com/news/2023/07/27/nancy-mace-child-care-republicans-00108486 [https://www.politico.com/news/2023/07/27/nancy-mace-child-care-republicans-00108486]
Rep. Nancy Mace [https://twitter.com/RepNancyMace/status/1684928879235072000?s=20]
Nancy Mace attended a POLITICO event [https://www.politico.com/news/2023/07/27/nancy-mace-child-care-republicans-00108486] last week, where she warned that Republicans need to refocus on "child care, maternal care, prenatal care [and] abortion" if they want to keep control of the House.
It was more cheap talk from Mace, who — time and again — has flip-flopped on the issues that matter most to women and working families.
https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2023/jul/15/nancy-mace-abortion-vote-hypocrisy-republicans?emci=9f4780c9-692d-ee11-b8f0-00224832eb73&emdi=ea000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001&ceid= [https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2023/jul/15/nancy-mace-abortion-vote-hypocrisy-republicans?emci=9f4780c9-692d-ee11-b8f0-00224832eb73&emdi=ea000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001&ceid=]
The Guardian [https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2023/jul/15/nancy-mace-abortion-vote-hypocrisy-republicans]
Here are the facts:
*
In
2019,
Nancy
Mace
voted
for
a
six-week
abortion
ban
[https://www.scstatehouse.gov/votehistory.php?KEY=16575]
in
the
South
Carolina
legislature.
*
In
2021,
she
voted
against
the
expansion
of
the
child
tax
credit
[https://mace.house.gov/media/press-releases/mace-so-called-american-rescue-plan-was-never-about-covid-19-relief]
in
the
American
Rescue
Plan.
*
In
January,
she
co-sponsored
H.R.
7
[https://www.dailykos.com/stories/2023/7/5/2179435/-My-opponent-is-co-sponsoring-another-extreme-bill]
,
which
would
make
health
coverage
that
includes
reproductive
care
ineligible
for
federal
funding.
*
In
July,
she
voted
for
an
NDAA
amendment
that
makes
it
harder
for
servicewomen
to
access
health
care
[https://www.dailykos.com/stories/2023/7/17/2181768/-Nancy-Mace-called-it-an-asshole-move-Then-she-voted-for-it]
—
a
policy
she
herself
called
an
"asshole
move."
Nothing about Nancy Mace's record is pro-children or pro-women. She should stop pretending otherwise.
On social media
https://twitter.com/michael_b_moore [https://twitter.com/michael_b_moore]
Michael surpassed 6,600 Twitter followers [https://twitter.com/michael_b_moore] this week! Can you help us reach 7,500 followers before the end of the month?
And if you aren't already, make sure to keep up with our campaign on Facebook [https://www.facebook.com/MichaelBMooreforCongress] , Instagram [https://www.instagram.com/mbm_sc01/] , Threads [https://www.threads.net/@mbm_sc01] , LinkedIn [https://www.linkedin.com/company/moore4sc/about/] and TikTok. [https://www.tiktok.com/@michaelbmoore4sc]
From the trail
https://join.legionm.com/robert-smalls-defiant/ [https://join.legionm.com/robert-smalls-defiant/]
Michael had a fun weekend at San Diego Comic-Con, where he helped some talented artists promote a forthcoming graphic novel [https://join.legionm.com/robert-smalls-defiant/] about his great-great-grandfather: Civil War hero and Recontruction-era Congressman Robert Smalls.
https://screenrant.com/defiant-the-story-of-robert-smalls-sdcc-interview/ [https://screenrant.com/defiant-the-story-of-robert-smalls-sdcc-interview/]
At a time when Republican politicians like Ron DeSantis are seeking to rewrite our nation's history [https://www.msnbc.com/the-reidout/reidout-blog/ron-desantis-florida-slavery-curriculum-rcna96052] — exploiting partisan divides at the expense of our children's education — Michael believes it's more important than ever for leaders to embrace the totality of America's legacy.
https://blackgirlnerds.com/the-creative-team-behind-defiant-the-robert-smalls-story/ [https://blackgirlnerds.com/the-creative-team-behind-defiant-the-robert-smalls-story/]
Part of that important work is elevating the stories of lesser-known patriots like Robert Smalls, who — in the face of unfathomable hardship — never stopped working to make America a more perfect Union [https://www.nps.gov/people/robert-smalls.htm] .
Michael is proud to be seeking the same House seat that his great-great-grandfather held nearly 140 years ago.
On our team
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/michael.b.moore-sc.1st-newsletter [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/michael.b.moore-sc.1st-newsletter]
There's so much work to do, and we're only just getting started.
Join us in our fight to flip this swing district.
Together — indivisible — we'll build a brighter future for South Carolina.

name: Your America
subject: National Referendum on Religious Liberty
body:
I want to remind you of some things we’ve seen (and lived through) in recent years--which we never thought we’d see in our country...

This sponsored message from Your America News is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c30260%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=UHeeUDh%2fOWL%2bJhGoZ09ZtA&sysid=1) Dear Friend, You have been selected by Hillsdale College to represent your state in a **National Referendum on Religious Liberty.** The referendum will only take a few moments of your time. Before you complete it, I want to remind you of some things we’ve seen (and lived through) in recent years--which we never thought we’d see in our country...
* Government mandates forcing Christian churches to close while casinos, strip clubs, and drug dispensaries remained open.

* Far-Left activists targeting Christian business owners, Christian teachers, and Christian coaches through litigation.

* The weaponizing of the Department of Justice and the FBI against Christian pro-life advocates who are defined as believing in “extremist ideologies” and having the potential for “domestic terrorism.”

* Christians in the workplace being forced to hide their faith while critical race theory and transgenderism are promoted.

**That’s why I’m asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Referendum on Religious Liberty.** By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of the American people on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty--including religious liberty. Friend, you can complete the **National Referendum on Religious Liberty** by using the secure link below: [**https://lp.hillsdale.edu/religious-liberty-survey/**](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c30261%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=fBIftR%2f3JlmTdLO4AC9zrg&sysid=1) Like the founders of our nation, the founders of Hillsdale College understood the essential connection between faith and freedom. **The College was founded in 1844 to offer “sound learning” in order to preserve “the inestimable blessings...of civil and religious liberty.”** Yet today’s ruling class mocks people of faith as “backward,” “bigots,” and even “Christo-fascists.” Politicians like Barack Obama claim that people like you “get bitter” and “cling to guns or religion.” These so-called elites are full of contempt for you and for Christianity and will not protect your civil and religious liberties. You and I know that religious liberty in America is under serious threat. But we can reverse course. **The first step is ...EDUCATION.** Today’s government policies that threaten religious liberty were conceived and implemented by people deceived by far-Left propaganda in our K-12 schools, colleges, and universities. That’s why a vital part of this fight--in which Hillsdale College is a leader--is **reaching** and **teaching** millions of citizens the TRUTH about America’s great heritage of religious liberty. We are heavily invested in our educational outreach efforts through our **Project to Save Religious Liberty in America.** These efforts include:
* **Teaching nearly 1,600 undergraduate and graduate students** --on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.--who bring their traditional faith with them as they join the fight to restore liberty and constitutional government in our country.

* **Distributing _Imprimis_** , America’s leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.6 million homes and businesses ten times per year. Previous issues include “Inside the Transgender Empire” by Christopher F. Rufo, “The Most Important Decision in Life” by Bishop Robert Barron, and “The Politicization of the Department of Justice” by Harmeet K. Dhillon.

* **Producing and promoting free online courses** for any citizen who wishes to learn on topics such as Christianity, the Constitution, American history, and free market economics. Several courses (including “The Genesis Story: Reading Biblical Narratives,” “Ancient Christianity,” and “C.S. Lewis on Christianity”) consider the important connection between faith and liberty.

* **Providing a classical K-12 curriculum** with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide.

After everything we’ve seen in recent years, the need for Hillsdale’s educational outreach efforts is undeniable. So please share your views by completing the **National Referendum on Religious Liberty** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few moments of your time. Your completed survey will help us to develop the most effective strategy to **reach** and **teach** millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. As you might know, Hillsdale College refuses to accept ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. **This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations. Thanks to our generous donors, we remain true to our original mission, even as many other colleges and universities reject religious liberty and embrace radical and dangerous ideologies.** I hope you will partner with Hillsdale College by making a generous tax-deductible gift today. You can easily do so after completing the **National Referendum on Religious Liberty** , which you can access at this secure link: [**https://lp.hillsdale.edu/religious-liberty-survey/**](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c30261%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=fBIftR%2f3JlmTdLO4AC9zrg&sysid=1) Thank you for your support of Hillsdale’s educational outreach efforts on behalf of religious liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844 |

# Affordable Housing: A Necessity for All

Peter:
The younger generation faces the harsh reality of unaffordable housing, grappling with the challenge of securing stable homes of their own.
As housing prices soar, many young people find themselves priced out of the market, unable to afford decent living situations. This lack of affordable housing not only undermines their ability to achieve homeownership but also threatens their financial security, perpetuating a cycle of instability and uncertainty.
**This not only impacts their quality of life but also limits their ability to save and invest in their future.**
By prioritizing policies that promote affordable housing and financial assistance programs, we can empower the younger generation to achieve stable housing and secure financial futures, ensuring that everyone has the opportunity to thrive and succeed.

[San Diego, California](https://www.kennedy24.com/san-diego-reception?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=weekly_newsletter_3_4_24_e1r&n=6) \- Tuesday, March 26th at 6:00 PM

[Dallas, Texas](https://www.kennedy24.com/dallas-texas-reception?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=weekly_newsletter_3_4_24_e1r&n=7) \- Sunday, April 14th at 4:00 PM
Elevate your support for Robert F. Kennedy, Jr.'s presidential campaign at an intimate fundraising reception. Enjoy delectable hors d’oeuvres and cocktails while partaking in a fireside chat and an inspiring Q&A session.
[Palos Verdes, California](https://www.kennedy24.com/palos-verdes?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=weekly_newsletter_3_4_24_e1r&n=8) \- Thursday, April 18th at 6:00 PM
This private reception is an opportunity to see and hear RFK, Jr. up close and personal. It includes remarks by the candidate, an intimate Q&A, and photo opportunity for all.
|
* * *
---
RFK Jr.: The Double Standard Of Secret Service Protection
Ex-Secret Service agent and political commentator Dan Bongino is as baffled as I am why a congressional advisory committee just voted in favor of granting Nikki Haley Secret Service protection when I have been denied the same protection.
Refusing me protection is a way to [drain my campaign funds](https://www.kennedy24.com/donate?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=weekly_newsletter_3_4_24_e1r&n=9), stop the movement we’re building together, and get us out of the race by any means necessary. This is blatant election interference.
While I agree Nikki Haley deserves protection and have immense respect for the Secret Service, double standards abound.
My campaign first requested Secret Service protection in May 2023; our request remains pending. It’s the first time in 55 years a presidential candidate has been denied.
Unfortunately for the establishment, I’m not going anywhere. A coalition is building. Most Americans agree huge shifts are needed, but the political elite are doing everything they can to keep that from happening. **Give me a sword and some ground to stand on, and we will take our country back.**

| Fellow American,

There is a very concerning trend occurring in our country that has me worried for Americans who hold to biblical & faith-based values. [](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=2a241ad725df4c828a5682d01e3e82ad&_e=cMFNxH81Hw0BLjGqZ8i81CvqAPCBV13y9pTrDsBx8vsD6xk1Wzt7hDQWeNBocy_brrxdanHDkM_dx2lyupPSp3gcnYVHfKPhU69T0I_5A7e50tx1wKQeGN8KkYHDlus8DVygAhxPwqT9uhQUjXlrc8wHBdfmtrX2nwC_tv3zwmhh1g7_Rs1Vnc3bAbZhQKCqoyMZ5j1UTpVxLa7tFDFQ_XWw91PFetEDDA9JrhqtFyoHv5LLu63nAJFEzh6CqVyWm_F0emDrNc4fOPl7zDiWmnTjsgfCqecxGGuQZMTqRDjJUJRYt4zXMK2b69ExOrMTpz3s-q3oixk0tC06uo5QVrkUKsHjR0cndMorL1rc9c6KY2bSZdc-DiuEncjibVfDcqLfUbn_fobLuIG_960cYsIYG1nfnoCVNxdCZHZI1Jw%3D) After the _Respect for Marriage Act_ was passed by a bi-partisan effort and signed into law, I am fearful that legal persecution will only intensify against Americans holding to faith-based values and who wish to conduct their lives according to their faith.

[**Are you concerned that America is abandoning a basic tenet of our founding -_Religious Liberty?_**](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=2a241ad725df4c828a5682d01e3e82ad&_e=cMFNxH81Hw0BLjGqZ8i81CvqAPCBV13y9pTrDsBx8vsD6xk1Wzt7hDQWeNBocy_brrxdanHDkM_dx2lyupPSp3gcnYVHfKPhU69T0I_5A7e50tx1wKQeGN8KkYHDlus8DVygAhxPwqT9uhQUjXlrc8wHBdfmtrX2nwC_tv3zwmhh1g7_Rs1Vnc3bAbZhQKCqoyMZ5j1UTpVxLa7tFDFQ_XWw91PFetEDDA9JrhqtFyoHv5LLu63nAJFEzh6CqVyWm_F0emDrNc4fOPl7zDiWmlTKmkePuo0Hme_XmZWGDpA3r7teFgnCqSb2_r9JR7jXolY2KwnbqYmdkeb3CDWa58QdHNoXUCzgPBozG4_LkIJltK6AxMy5uO6Wi9xqpnMJzTAITUwTtD9j5jD495buthLclPWwwQ6sWAY5j7c9gbo%3D)

In addition to the passing of the _Respect for Marriage Act_ , numerous examples over the past decade have concerned me: KENNEDY v. BREMERTON SCHOOL DISTRICT, MASTERPIECE CAKESHOP v. COLORADO CIVIL RIGHTS COMMISSION, and 303 CREATIVE v. ELENIS are just a few examples of legal persecution against Americans holding to faith-based values who wish to conduct their lives according to their faith.

Furthermore, an amendment to the _Respect for Marriage Act_ , brought forth by Senator Mike Lee, prohibiting the Federal Government from retaliating against schools, businesses, and organizations because of their religious beliefs about same-sex marriage failed.

**This has the potential to only intensify legal persecution against individuals, businesses, churches, and nonprofits holding to faith-based values. **

The American Cornerstone Institute is a non-profit that I founded to preserve and promote the cornerstones that laid the foundation for the greatest nation the world has ever seen: Faith, Liberty, Community, and Life.

Whether it is a football coach losing his job for praying at midfield after a game, or a baker being sued for not wanting to bake a cake that violates his religious values, **are you concerned as I am with the increase in legal persecution against Americans who wish to conduct their lives according to their faith?**

Please share your thoughts in this quick 2-minute survey concerning religious liberty in America.

**[https://offers.americancornerstone.org/religious-liberty-survey/](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=2a241ad725df4c828a5682d01e3e82ad&_e=cMFNxH81Hw0BLjGqZ8i81CvqAPCBV13y9pTrDsBx8vsD6xk1Wzt7hDQWeNBocy_brrxdanHDkM_dx2lyupPSp3gcnYVHfKPhU69T0I_5A7e50tx1wKQeGN8KkYHDlus8DVygAhxPwqT9uhQUjXlrc8wHBdfmtrX2nwC_tv3zwmhh1g7_Rs1Vnc3bAbZhQKCqoyMZ5j1UTpVxLa7tFDFQ_XWw91PFetEDDA9JrhqtFyoHv5LLu63nAJFEzh6CqVyWm_F0emDrNc4fOPl7zDiWmgfWqa7FWycKwPTs-pDl9Cs__5ZGNGz_pb-l7C1WR9latLgVRXSG-qN1Da_GJz1OPZmjczCvEYjRFi7WG4_N03YhUXgyCNxUqQimAYjUS-h-yVi8oAbsXarpnjYtNh4nu6yldFAJK4y1R5by8Y3Izmg%3D)**

Thank you for your consideration.

Regards,

Dr. Ben Carson
Founder & Chairman American Cornerstone Institute

Tomorrow is primary day in Texas! We’ve done so much work to get to this day. And, while we’ve been here before, we know a lot can happen between now and when the polls close.
What I know for sure is that a campaign takes a lot of work and a lot of money. And I am so grateful to everyone on this team who has shown up for our campaign this year, and in years past. Whether you volunteered your time, made a contribution, or voted early, it all makes a difference.
You are essential to our efforts to get our message in front of voters in every corner of the district so I can continue fighting for our values and priorities in Congress.
We plan to finish strong. I’m grateful for all those who have contributed to our Primary Challenge Goal. And for those deadline-oriented people like me who have been meaning to get to it, here is a link where you can make a contribution:
CONTRIBUTE [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lpfe240304?refcode=lpfe240304]

This morning, I officially qualified to appear on the ballot in the Republican primary for Georgia’s 3rd Congressional District.

It was an honor of a lifetime to serve our country as an Army Ranger, and to serve our state in the Georgia Senate.

Today, our country is in trouble, and I’m ready to serve again.

**[I recorded a quick video after qualifying that I hope you’ll watch, and I hope you’ll donate a few dollars to help the campaign begin this new phase the right way.](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/8c30722d3644710666a6b3c4b83ff292/45443/48f445d03d0cd5c73947229f28c3afba/d0357355242370e6c3d6b838967d376c/45443)**

[](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/8c30722d3644710666a6b3c4b83ff292/45443/48f445d03d0cd5c73947229f28c3afba/e8b7a23489b4f45ec3d6b838967d376c/45443)
---
In the days ahead, we’re going to continue crisscrossing Georgia’s 3rd District and listening to voters.

We’ll be launching our first digital ad buys.

And we’ll be printing more campaign materials.

Each of these efforts will cost a substantial amount of money. That’s the reality of running a campaign, and that’s why we ask for your support often.

But this is a fight worth having. Together, I know we can unite our party, win this primary, and make a real difference for Georgia’s 3rd District, and the entire country, in Congress.

**[I’m all-in. Are you? Let’s go.](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/8c30722d3644710666a6b3c4b83ff292/45443/48f445d03d0cd5c73947229f28c3afba/b6861c50e209f512c3d6b838967d376c/45443)**

Our highest court is held to the lowest ethical standards. And we just saw the consequences of these low standards: Justice Neil Gorsuch failed to recuse himself from major cases that could dismantle environmental and health regulations – which would make millions of dollars for his close friend, oil baron Philip Anschutz. [1] And unfortunately, Peter, this is just the latest in a long list of ethical violations from Justices Clarence Thomas, Samuel Alito, and Neil Gorsuch – from private trips with billionaire donors to undisclosed tuition and real estate deals. [2] We must demand better from our highest court. **[Tell Congress: Pass the Supreme Court Ethics, Recusal, and Transparency Act and create a REAL, enforceable code of conduct to hold SCOTUS accountable.](https://default.salsalabs.org/T66ad901d-5fc2-4090-a6b0-87514af1b94c/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)**

body:

| | Dear Fellow American, “The Constitution is kind of trash.” That’s what a guest--with an Ivy League degree--said recently on a highly-rated daytime talk show. You’ve likely seen how “progressives” in the media, Big Tech, and politics are amplifying attacks on our nation’s principles of limited government and personal liberty with outrageous statements like “The Constitution is kind of trash.” And like that television pundit I mentioned, they are pushing a narrative that our Constitution is **flawed** , **outdated** , and **incapable** of dealing with the challenges of our time. Thankfully, a few early champions of the Constitution--Alexander Hamilton, John Jay, and James Madison--gave you and me the perfect guide to understanding its timeless principles: _The Federalist Papers_.
---
| | Written between October 1787 and August 1788 under the pen name Publius, _The Federalist Papers_ were originally published as newspaper editorials intended to explain the merits of the Constitution. Thomas Jefferson described them as “the best commentary on the principles of government which ever was written.” And these documents are just as relevant today as they were back then. If we’re serious about solving the current issues in our country, we shouldn’t run from them. We should embrace them. **That’s why I want to send you our entire 10-lesson course,["_The Federalist Papers_ ,"](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zi94sabfnaekansjk6bf96i9cjjsj3s1tmnl02eo_rp22sh2s8i6eo34slge4pr7cth2bs)**** on DVD today when you make a tax-deductible donation of $100 or more to Hillsdale College.**

You’ve likely seen how “progressives” in the media, Big Tech, and politics are amplifying attacks on our nation’s principles of limited government and personal liberty with outrageous statements like “The Constitution is kind of trash.” And like that television pundit I mentioned, they are pushing a narrative that our Constitution is flawed , outdated , and incapable of dealing with the challenges of our time. Thankfully, a few early champions of the Constitution--Alexander Hamilton, John Jay, and James Madison--gave you and me the perfect guide to understanding its timeless principles: The Federalist Papers. | | Written between October 1787 and August 1788 under the pen name Publius, The Federalist Papers were originally published as newspaper editorials intended to explain the merits of the Constitution. Thomas Jefferson described them as “the best commentary on the principles of government which ever was written.” And these documents are just as relevant today as they were back then. If we’re serious about solving the current issues in our country, we shouldn’t run from them. We should embrace them. That’s why I want to send you our entire 10-lesson course, on DVD today when you make a tax-deductible donation of $100 or more to Hillsdale College. | | | “The Federalist Papers” course comes in a beautiful DVD box set for viewing in your home or a small group. You might also find it useful for a homeschool curriculum or personal study. Hillsdale’s faculty teach the course, and it will deepen your understanding of this incredibly relevant document even more. These DVDs also make a great gift for someone unfamiliar with our nation’s founding principles--maybe even a friend or family member. But supplies are limited. So, be sure to get this special edition of “The Federalist Papers” on DVD today. More than 200,000 people have already taken this course, so this DVD box set won’t last long. body:
| | | Hi friend, it’s Carole King, and I really do write these emails.

Recently, I worked with the DSCC on a survey to learn what matters most to our fellow citizens.

**In no particular order, here are some answers:**

* Stop Republicans from undermining the democracy that's taken this country 240+ years to build and protect.
* Voting rights, voting rights, voting rights!
* Help people and small businesses rather than big corporations.
* Pay teachers as if we valued them as much as executives.
* Combat climate change and keep us from reaching the environmental tipping points that scientists warned us about in the 20th century.

But wait. Can you guess what the most common answer was?

_All of the above._

[**We need to _supercharge_ our Democratic Senate majority if we're going to make these priorities a reality. So please, will you contribute $5 today to expand our majority so Democrats can continue making progress for us and our families?**](https://go.dscc.org/go/17465?amount=5&t=6&firstname=&lastname=&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&addr1=&addr2=&city=Cresco&state=Pennsylvania&zip=18326&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&ask=5&amounts=5%2C10%2C20%2C50&code=DPE-FD-20240304-CaroleKing-CaroleKingSurveyResponseFR-Pros-sl1&refcode=DPE-FD-20240304-CaroleKing-CaroleKingSurveyResponseFR-Pros-sl1&akid=13784%2E9716520%2EFzC9sg)

**With a supercharged Senate majority, Democrats will be able to achieve many of the things that matter to each and every one of us.**

I’m calling on you to help elect _as many Democrats as possible_ to the Senate. Why do we need more than 50 or 51?

Even in the minority, Senate Republicans have enough power to block our progress. With enough votes, Senate Democrats can and WILL deliver solutions to the problems that keep you up at night.

We’ve seen Democrats use their power to lift families and communities. We’ve also seen Republicans use their power to take away our rights and freedoms.

**We have the power to choose. I choose lifting. Will you join me?**

The MAGA agenda is dangerous. And the best way to smack down the MAGA agenda (which appears to be whatever Trump wants on a given day) is for Democrats to win the elections in November by a wide margin.

[**Supercharging our Democratic Senate majority is one of the most important things we can do to continue our progress, so I hope you'll join me today by donating $5 to help us get more than just a simple majority of Democrats in the Senate.**](https://go.dscc.org/go/17465?amount=5&t=7&firstname=&lastname=&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&addr1=&addr2=&city=Cresco&state=Pennsylvania&zip=18326&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&ask=5&amounts=5%2C10%2C20%2C50&code=DPE-FD-20240304-CaroleKing-CaroleKingSurveyResponseFR-Pros-sl1&refcode=DPE-FD-20240304-CaroleKing-CaroleKingSurveyResponseFR-Pros-sl1&akid=13784%2E9716520%2EFzC9sg)

Thank you for joining me in this existential fight to save our democracy and accomplish more of the goals expressed in the survey.

With my very best wishes to you and your family,
-Carole

subject: Confronting Maternal Mortality in Philadelphia
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Nina for Philly
body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ninageneral [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ninageneral]
Hi Friend,
Recently, I was privileged to introduce a Resolution authorizing the Committee on Public Health and Human Services to hold hearings examining proposed solutions to racial disparities in the maternal mortality rate in the City of Philadelphia . This is an issue that has meant a great deal to me for many years and I can't wait to amplify and build on the work already done by my colleagues to address this tragic injustice.
You might be surprised to learn that maternal mortality has increased more than fourfold in the United States since 1987 with over 80% of those deaths deemed as preventable. Unsurprisingly, and importantly in Philadelphia, this crisis affects black women at a significantly higher rate than other populations. This is unacceptable .
The ripple effect of a mother's death on her children, her family, and her community is immeasurable. I know this all too well as my own maternal grandmother sadly passed in childbirth leaving my own mother without her at only 2 years old. The reverberations of that loss have been felt in my own family for generations and have helped to shape me in countless ways.
The good news? If we take action, the majority of these deaths are preventable. I intend to do just that.
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP59/1/106735/images/Screen%20Shot%202024-02-20%20at%2010.22.22%20AM.png]
As always, I am endlessly optimistic for Philadelphia and deeply grateful for your support. I carry you with me each and every day.
I look forward to hearing more from you and ask for your continued partnership in the hard work of improving the lives of every Philadelphian. I know that we can do this together!
Thank you again,
Councilmember Nina Ahmad

subject: [SIGN ON] Tell Congress we’re not backing down in the fight for universal background checks
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Giffords PAC; not authorized by any candidate or candidate's committee
body:
Passing universal background checks is a simple action, but it speaks volumes about the size of the movement to change our gun laws.
#

Friends -
With the passage of the Bipartisan Safer Communities Act in 2022, we now have enhanced background checks for gun buyers under 21 in our country. This is a huge step forward in our movement for gun safety, and according to FBI data, enhanced background checks have helped stop hundreds of young adults who should not be able to buy a gun from obtaining one.
But we still need to make sure that a background check happens every single time a gun is sold. And that means Congress must pass universal background checks legislation.
Saving lives from gun violence starts with making sure people who should not be allowed to have guns aren’t able to buy them.
The only place this idea is controversial is Congress.
[**Will you add your name to our petition calling on Congress to pass universal background checks?**](https://go.giffords.org/signup/giffords_em_ubc_pet_mar24/?source=em240304-1-30&refcode2=7717.3935704.LhlGSz&akid=7717%2E3935704%2ELhlGSz)
**[ADD YOUR NAME](https://go.giffords.org/signup/giffords_em_ubc_pet_mar24/?source=em240304-1-30&refcode2=7717.3935704.LhlGSz&akid=7717%2E3935704%2ELhlGSz)**
Passing universal background checks is a simple action, but it speaks volumes about the size of the movement to change our gun laws.
That’s why we must keep the pressure on and let our elected officials in Congress know that we’re not backing down in our demands to pass universal background checks.
[**Please, use this link to say you want Congress to pass universal background checks for gun purchases in the United States.**](https://go.giffords.org/signup/giffords_em_ubc_pet_mar24/?source=em240304-1-30&refcode2=7717.3935704.LhlGSz&akid=7717%2E3935704%2ELhlGSz)

Thank you for standing with us,
The GIFFORDS Team

We try to send only the most important information and opportunities to participate via email, but click [here](https://go.giffords.org/unsubscribe/unsubscribe/?t=1&akid=7717%2E3935704%2ELhlGSz) if you'd like to unsubscribe. **The current administration 's weaponization of the Department of Justice is unprecedented in American history.**

Instead of protecting your God-given constitutional rights, the administration uses the Department of Justice to attack its political opponents...

...as well as Christians, parents, and anyone who dares to stand up for our constitutional liberties.

At the same time, with the help of the media it...

Covers up a two-tiered justice system that violates your constitutional rights
Hides the corruption of the ruling class
Attacks those with traditional viewpoints

**That 's why I'm asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Survey on the Department of Justice.**

By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans like you on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty--including the importance of the rule of law and checks and balances, which the American Founders saw as essential safeguards against corruption.

Thank you for your time and attention. I look forward to receiving your completed survey, and I sincerely appreciate your support of Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty.

As family doctor running for Congress, I've been on the frontlines of women's healthcare for four decades. I will fiercely fight for a woman's right to choose. Help me get to Congress to be the 'doctor in the House' that protects reproductive freedom.
CONTRIBUTE TO CHOICE [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/about-bob]
Friend,
On Thursday, nearly 150 Republican lawmakers, including my opponent Rep. Jack Bergman, asked the Supreme Court to restrict access to the abortion drug mifepristone — citing a law from 1873.
Our granddaughters should not have to fight the same battles that their grandmothers already won.
The GOP brief referred to the 19th-century Comstock Act, a zombie law that conservatives want Donald Trump to enforce if he wins as a way to ban abortion nationwide without Congress.
Friend, it could be used to not only ban medication abortion, but by prohibiting shipments of medical supplies used in clinics, it could outright ban abortion procedures in all 50 states. Yes, even ones with laws that protect abortion.
We cannot afford to go backward. Please join my fight against Bergman's federal abortion ban. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/about-bob]
Mifepristone has been used for over 20 years by over five million people. Commonly prescribed drugs like Penicillin, Tylenol, and Viagra have higher death rates than this abortion medication.
The GOP nonsense isn't based on science or safety; It's right-wing activism.
A contribution from you today of any amount can help Democrats regain the majority in Congress, get religion out of politics, advocate for judicial reform, and codify Roe into federal law.
Thank you.
-Dr. Bob

Jack Bergman, asked the Supreme Court to restrict access to the abortion drug mifepristone — citing a law from 1873. Our granddaughters should not have to fight the same battles that their grandmothers already won. The GOP brief referred to the 19th-century Comstock Act, a zombie law that conservatives want Donald Trump to enforce if he wins as a way to ban abortion nationwide without Congress. Friend, it could be used to not only ban medication abortion, but by prohibiting shipments of medical supplies used in clinics, it could outright ban abortion procedures in all 50 states. Yes, even ones with laws that protect abortion. We cannot afford to go backward. Please join my fight against Bergman's federal abortion ban. [] Mifepristone has been used for over 20 years by over five million people. Commonly prescribed drugs like Penicillin, Tylenol, and Viagra have higher death rates than this abortion medication. The GOP nonsense isn't based on science or safety; It's right-wing activism. A contribution from you today of any amount can help Democrats regain the majority in Congress, get religion out of politics, advocate for judicial reform, and codify Roe into federal law.
