name: Patti Reilly
subject: My son was wrongly convicted
body:
_
I was so proud that night. But I was also terrified.

Dear Friend,

I know you and I have never met. But I'm praying that you'll help me save my son, Officer Terence Sutton.

This is a picture of Terence and me at a dinner celebrating his graduation from the Police Academy.
[](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2za3um8h5sboh2gt8hbv38v05f08g78qvhu1ph5lo_rp22sh2s8i6eo34slge6o34c3h2bs)
I was so proud that night. But I was also terrified.

Terence was going to be patrolling the streets of Washington, DC, where crime is sky-high and politicians side with criminals over cops. But never in my wildest imagination could I have predicted that my son would be _wrongfully_ _convicted_ _of_ _murder_ **- murder of a criminal my son didn't even touch.**

The story is so shocking that if it didn't happen to my son, _I wouldn 't even believe it._ **[And I'm praying you will help me save my son](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z1rv25qppknrsd3t0cf907hm7qt0dlh8s5obvqm8_rp22sh2s8i6eo34slge6o34c3h2bs)** - **but first, let me explain what happened.**

Our nightmare started in October of 2020.

Terence was sitting in his patrol car when he received a report that a known gang member, Karon Hylton-Brown, was seen entering a rival gang's territory.

Karon was a violent criminal with a rap sheet a mile long - including drugs, illegal gun possession, and assaults. Earlier that day, he had been seen arguing with a rival gang member who owed him money. Terence and other officers were concerned Karon was planning to get revenge.

So when Terence saw him illegally driving a motorized scooter on the sidewalk without a helmet, he tried to pull Karon over to talk. Instead, Karon took off on the scooter.

Terence watched as Karon sped through traffic, weaving in and out of cars and blowing past red lights and stop signs.

My son knew Karon was putting others at risk, so for 3 minutes he slowly and carefully followed behind in his patrol car.

And then it happened.

Karon veered into an alleyway, drove out the other side without looking and slammed into a passing car.

After several days in the hospital, Karon died from his injuries. And here's where the story takes a shocking turn...

Because Karon was black, and the incident happened just four months after George Floyd's death, the anti-police mob went into frenzy.

They blamed Terence for the accident and smeared him as a racist.

There were protests and even riots. The mob threw rocks at officers, smashed store windows, and set fires.

Anti-police politicians piled on too. Without any evidence, they demanded my son be charged even though he did nothing to cause Karon's death.

The pressure campaign worked, and prosecutors charged my son with _**Second-Degree Murder.**_

When Terence called to tell me about the charges, I was in disbelief. Any sane person could see that Karon's death, while tragic, was no one's fault but his own.

_He_ chose to run from the cops.

_He_ chose to not wear a helmet.

_He_ chose to speed through that alley without looking where he was going.

So, when I learned that Terence could be sentenced to **_sixty_ _years_** in prison for Karon's death, my head started spinning. And it only got worse when the trial began.

You see, the judge refused to allow Terence's legal team to present all of the facts in his defense.

The jury never got to hear that Karon was a known member of a violent gang...

They never got to hear that he was wearing an ankle monitor because of a violent assault he had committed just weeks before...

They never got to hear that he had drugs and thousands of dollars in cash strapped to his leg...

And they never got to hear about the drugs in Karon's system at the time of the crash.

Sitting in the courtroom, I couldn't believe my ears when the jury filed out and declared Terence _**" guilty."**_

He's currently awaiting sentencing.

Now you understand why I'm so heartbroken. The injustice is almost too much to bear.

My son was well-respected by the community he served. He trained many Rookies and set a good example for all of them.

He was even awarded Officer of the Year!

And at the same time the bleeding-heart DC politicians are letting shoplifters, carjackers, and drug dealers walk away scot-free...

...they're trying to put my son - a decorated officer who has received 60 awards and commendations - away for 60 years for something he _didn 't_ _do._

I had almost lost hope, but then we learned about the **Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund** -or LELDF for short.

If you've ever heard of LELDF, you know they're a national group fighting on behalf of wrongly-accused police officers like Terence. LELDF has helped dozens of innocent cops - and their families - at their lowest moments. And when I got the call from their president, Jason Johnson, I was at my lowest moment.

Not only did LELDF decide to help my son get the legal defense he deserves. They're also raising money to pay for the best attorneys and expert witnesses for Terence.

So I have to ask you one of the toughest questions I've ever asked anyone:

**[Will you help my son Terence fight the unjust charges against him by donating to LELDF?](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zudfjfvffino3tls45vbdr4r60gmuodl165nlloo_rp22sh2s8i6eo34slge6o34c3h2bs)**

To fund his defense, Terence had to sell his home, his car, his beloved motorcycle, and most of his personal belongings. Everything he owns now fits in just nine small boxes. He has almost nothing left.

If I had anywhere else to turn, I wouldn't be so bold as to ask for your help.

But I already lost my husband. He was a police officer too, and he was so proud that Terence followed in his footsteps. And it makes me cry when I think of how he would feel about what Terence is being put through right now.

I simply can't bear the thought of having another family member ripped away from me.

**[So if you are at all able, would you consider following this link to make a tax-deductible donation to the Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund to help my Terence?](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z0maeho83t5hnknj7fq7fs2hlugs8t794chlg5u0_rp22sh2s8i6eo34slge6o34c3h2bs)**

**Any amount - $35, $50, $100, or even $500 or more - will help.**

And because LELDF is a non-profit organization, your gift is completely tax-deductible. But whatever you can afford to give, I ask that you rush it back quickly.

Terence's team is currently looking at every available option to keep his case alive.

**[And you and your $35 contribution could make the difference in Terence being acquitted or spending the next 60 years behind bars.](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zrhgeg7dbds1d2vcimgtul8pvbm8vpo1l0otil08_rp22sh2s8i6eo34slge6o34c3h2bs)**

Right now, Terence can only rely on the good nature and generosity of kind neighbors like you.

Thank you for taking the time to read my letter today.

And thank you - in advance - for doing what you can to help all the wrongly-accused officers LELDF is working with. Like Terence.

Sincerely,

Patti Reilly

P.S. I know a few kind words from someone like you will help lift Terence's spirits. This guilty verdict has been so devastating for him. **[So if you choose to make a $35 gift to LELDF, would you also please include a little note-maybe a prayer?](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zn4sji7jkra22o8raa2443bitmi12ik7445fko6g_rp22sh2s8i6eo34slge6o34c3h2bs)** There's a field on the page for you to do this. Thank you -from the bottom of my heart.

| | [](https://click.everyaction.com/k/80273937/458880952/992867983?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNTkcvMS85OTMyMCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwZGQ0NWFkOC00NGRhLWVlMTEtODVmOS0wMDIyNDgyMjM3OTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=rH_MH6jc-uXNr6mGoZLu2mB-_O57NpJ2TJqoU6ZUO4I=&emci=eb90ee30-cfd4-ee11-85f9-002248223794&emdi=0dd45ad8-44da-ee11-85f9-002248223794&ceid=6787172) Hi team — From the bottom of my heart, I want to sincerely thank you for helping us reach our February fundraising goal. Your support means more than you can possibly imagine. I’ll be honest: The work we do here at NextGen has become more critical than ever. Young Americans will have a huge role to play in November’s election. Whether or not we’ll be able to hold on to our democracy and progressive ideals will likely come down to whether young voters show up to the polls. We can’t stop reaching out to young voters and encouraging them to make a difference for even a second. And we rely on your grassroots support to be able to make an impact. So thank you for everything you’ve done so far to help us reach our goals. **[And if you haven’t already, or if you just want to keep pushing us forward, consider chipping in today so we can start off March on the right foot.](https://click.everyaction.com/k/80273938/458880953/-921829656?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNTkcvMS85OTMyMCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwZGQ0NWFkOC00NGRhLWVlMTEtODVmOS0wMDIyNDgyMjM3OTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=rH_MH6jc-uXNr6mGoZLu2mB-_O57NpJ2TJqoU6ZUO4I=&emci=eb90ee30-cfd4-ee11-85f9-002248223794&emdi=0dd45ad8-44da-ee11-85f9-002248223794&ceid=6787172)** Progress is possible. Let’s keep pushing forward until it’s a reality. body:
Who will be on the ballot in November?

| Peter -- Spring is right around the corner and so is election season. **Read on to learn more - and mark your calendar for the March Statewide Meeting on March 18 th at 8 pm!** **[](https://home.forwardparty.com/pa_fwd_march_statewide_meeting_20240318?e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=march_2024_newsletter&n=1)**
# Save the Date- March 26th
This will be the kind of day that we all look forward to. We'll be able to share more details as we get closer and of course discuss the details at our Statewide Call. Join us as we embark on a journey from events originating in Pittsburgh and Philadelphia to a combined event in Harrisburg. We'll be joined by some familiar faces from National Leadership and some new faces that you'll get to know very well between now and November.
* * *
## Thank you to everyone that participated in our Leap Forward campaign!
### Support breeds support
Whether you attended one of our Leap Forward Day events or made a financial contribution, we appreciate your support as we prepare for our biggest year yet. About 50 people participated in one way or another and we even inspired some other states to hold their own Leap Forward Day Campaigns. We'll have to do it again in 2028!
* * *
## If you are considering running for office in November...
## There are some things you might not be aware of.
Anyone that wants to get on the ballot in November as an independent or 3rd party, needs to not be a registered Democrat or Republican as of 30 days before the Primary. The Primary is April 23rd so you only have about two weeks to change your registration if that's an option you'd like to have. The races we'd most like to compete in this year are the State house races. Please take a moment to look up your State Representative and learn about the race. You could even reach out to the people running and ask if they have positions on Ranked Choice Voting/ Open Primaries and the other issues that matter most to you. We'd love to hear what you find, and if you find that you'd like more information about running, please reach out. | [](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=oWVdeJ5gFtjwqaJ3WtsOlzYNvSHRFg8ChPcBWWy_rWSSqlhllQw-xDIQc1SzB57Tezqq0Cr9lSx9zTGRCbYuziAxeah7bsWhyzWoA2eQj78&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=march_2024_newsletter&n=2 "Find your Legislator") [Find your Legislator](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=oWVdeJ5gFtjwqaJ3WtsOlzYNvSHRFg8ChPcBWWy_rWSSqlhllQw-xDIQc1SzB57Tezqq0Cr9lSx9zTGRCbYuziAxeah7bsWhyzWoA2eQj78&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=march_2024_newsletter&n=2)
---
* * *
**Here are our other goals for 2024:**
* We will run a Statewide Candidate who wins 2% of the statewide total.
* We will run several State House Candidates in the hopes of winning enough to prevent either of the major parties from achieving a majority.
* We will build our volunteer base across the Commonwealth.
* We will identify & develop leaders at the Regional & County levels.
* We will dramatically increase the number of monthly donors.

_**The Pennsylvania Forward Party needs you**_. We are looking for [candidates to run under or with the Forward Party](https://www.forwardparty.com/runforoffice/?e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=march_2024_newsletter&n=3) in 2024. Don't want to run as a candidate? Consider helping us by joining one of our committees. To find out how you can get involved, email [Pennsylvania@forwardparty.com](mailto:Pennsylvania@ForwardParty.com)

body:
My new TV Ad on fighting the fentanyl epidemic. Plus, another straw poll win and more! Major campaign updates in this email. 📧👀

https://www.crouchforindiana.com/?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=25c48238fc-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_02_27_02_42&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-25c48238fc-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D

Friends and fellow Hoosiers,

I hope this message finds you well. As we charge forward to the May Primary, I wanted to take a moment to provide you with an update on the past week's events and news.

Let's hit the highlights!

** NEW TV AD: 'A Time For Strength' (https://vimeo.com/918183427?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=25c48238fc-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_02_27_02_42&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-25c48238fc-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)
------------------------------------------------------------

Make no mistake: the fentanyl coming across our wide-open southern border is killing Hoosiers. Yet, Biden does nothing to stop it.

In my new ad (https://vimeo.com/918183427?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=25c48238fc-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_02_27_02_42&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-25c48238fc-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) , I send a clear message: I won't stand for it, and you shouldn't either. Under my leadership, Indiana will fight back.
https://vimeo.com/918183427?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=25c48238fc-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_02_27_02_42&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-25c48238fc-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D
WATCH (https://vimeo.com/918183427?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=25c48238fc-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_02_27_02_42&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-25c48238fc-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)

** ICYMI: Crouch wins Second Straw Poll
------------------------------------------------------------

It's an honor to have secured another victory at the Tippecanoe County Lincoln Day Dinner straw poll.

This win, coupled with our success at the 6th Congressional District Straw Poll, demonstrates the overwhelming support we have from Hoosiers across the state who want to #AxeTheTax, protect our state from Communist China's land grab attempts, and prioritize mental health.

** IN THE NEWS: C (https://fox59.com/news/politics/in-focus-crouch-opponents-prepare-for-debates/?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=25c48238fc-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_02_27_02_42&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-25c48238fc-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) rouch, opponents prepare for debates (https://fox59.com/news/politics/in-focus-crouch-opponents-prepare-for-debates/?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=25c48238fc-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_02_27_02_42&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-25c48238fc-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)
------------------------------------------------------------

I️ had a great conversation with Dan Spehler on IN Focus: Indiana Politics! From #AxeTheTax (https://www.facebook.com/hashtag/axethetax?__eep__=6&__cft__[0]=AZXsk7lWAR4tUJaKfKzzs9dB_z5-VCQ8D9VYUmupzNMQBLiLQH9bdROijxSlXI_XIlioJQrCvVtQsVRLQdP8aOqYH-fXWnYOJxYUYt8PJUAwaPOvzHgRDx4_G6bvkKSMgCgfYTiNBwl4PZoSflPlEZnU6qgt9vsZfLo5Pe9pxjiC9WbraLMUmnTER_gU_RF7vVI&__tn__=*NK-R&utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=25c48238fc-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_02_27_02_42&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-25c48238fc-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) to protecting Indiana from foreign threats and prioritizing mental health, I am laser-focused on advancing policies to empower Hoosiers and drive economic growth.
https://fox59.com/news/politics/in-focus-crouch-opponents-prepare-for-debates/?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=25c48238fc-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_02_27_02_42&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-25c48238fc-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D
ARTICLE (https://fox59.com/news/politics/in-focus-crouch-opponents-prepare-for-debates/?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=25c48238fc-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_02_27_02_42&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-25c48238fc-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)

** STATEMENT: Limiting Executive Powers (https://www.facebook.com/CrouchForIndiana/posts/pfbid02PG4w8GUd9Az68jE5Emda9Fk1mmkRJU1hrat56uo62Auk3kgD1eeeJGk2mPFc9yG3l?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=25c48238fc-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_02_27_02_42&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-25c48238fc-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)
------------------------------------------------------------

On Monday, the House will consider Senate Bill 234 to limit executive powers in an emergency. Since SB 234 was first filed, I am the only candidate to speak out in full support of this measure and will continue to advocate for it until it becomes law.

As Governor, I will ensure that Hoosiers have their voices heard. For our government to serve the people best, we need a balance of power. I am committed to working with legislators to ensure that Hoosiers always have a say in matters that directly impact their families and businesses, especially in a prolonged emergency situation.

As President of the Senate, I commend the Senate for their record of leadership in government reform.

** Professional Fire Fighters Union of Indiana
------------------------------------------------------------
https://www.wrtv.com/news/state-news/newborn-surrendered-in-southern-indiana-safe-haven-baby-box?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=25c48238fc-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_02_27_02_42&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-25c48238fc-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D

Speaking before the Professional Fire Fighters Union of Indiana's annual conference was an honor.

As Governor, I will always stand with our first responders and ensure they have the resources they need to keep us safe.

** Community Cares Tour stops in Boone, Tippecanoe Counties
------------------------------------------------------------
https://www.wrtv.com/news/state-news/newborn-surrendered-in-southern-indiana-safe-haven-baby-box?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=25c48238fc-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_02_27_02_42&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-25c48238fc-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D

Over the weekend, I embarked on my Community Cares Tour with Noblesville Mayor Chris Jensen.

We had insightful discussions with local leaders and community members in Boone and Tippecanoe counties about how we can continue to help our state thrive.

** Munster Lions Pancake Breakfast
------------------------------------------------------------
https://www.wrtv.com/news/state-news/newborn-surrendered-in-southern-indiana-safe-haven-baby-box?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=25c48238fc-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_02_27_02_42&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-25c48238fc-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D

Congratulations to the Munster Lions on their 84th Anniversary! Glad to celebrate with the Lions at their annual Pancake Breakfast over the weekend.

Their dedication to supporting community programs and causes is commendable.

** SEEN ON SOCIAL: March is Developmental Disabilities Awareness Month (https://www.facebook.com/CrouchForIndiana/posts/pfbid07aZtbfwh7M8N9Qdv4tiwmY529v7GuK4eAEFkodmnKxKRcMesgy3xVTLcjeZzPmZLl?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=25c48238fc-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_02_27_02_42&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-25c48238fc-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)

March is a time to celebrate the unique abilities and contributions of our friends with different abilities. They're just like us—they want to live, work, and play, and deserve every opportunity to do so.
https://www.facebook.com/CrouchForIndiana/posts/pfbid07aZtbfwh7M8N9Qdv4tiwmY529v7GuK4eAEFkodmnKxKRcMesgy3xVTLcjeZzPmZLl?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=25c48238fc-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_02_27_02_42&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-25c48238fc-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D

And while Tim Kaine was sitting on his butt in Washington DC, I was fighting on the front lines for our country. I saw America’s worst enemies face to face, and I risked my life to take them down. To call me a Nazi after spending my life serving this country is a whole new low, even for Tim Kaine. body:
I want to remind you of some things we’ve seen (and lived through) in recent years—which we never thought we’d see in our country...

This sponsored message from Restore Our Nation is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/VrtuC8SwkAtUXlo8Nktaeg~~/AARclAA~/RgRnyJewP0SxaHR0cHM6Ly9scC5oaWxsc2RhbGUuZWR1L3JlbGlnaW91cy1saWJlcnR5LXN1cnZleS8_c2M9MDEyNTNOMDI0MkwwQURPREVFUyZ1dG1fc291cmNlPXByb3NwZWN0aW5nJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPXJlbGlnaW91c2xpYmVydHlzdXJ2ZXkmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9UEEtUk9OLTIwMjQwMzA0VwNzcGNCCmXig__lZcezN0RSFGRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tWAQAAAAA) Dear Friend, You have been selected by Hillsdale College to represent your state in a **National Referendum on Religious Liberty.** The referendum will only take a few moments of your time. Before you complete it, I want to remind you of some things we've seen (and lived through) in recent years--which we never thought we'd see in our country...
* Government mandates forcing Christian churches to close while casinos, strip clubs, and drug dispensaries remained open.

* Far-Left activists targeting Christian business owners, Christian teachers, and Christian coaches through litigation.

* The weaponizing of the Department of Justice and the FBI against Christian pro-life advocates who are defined as believing in “extremist ideologies” and having the potential for “domestic terrorism.”

* Christians in the workplace being forced to hide their faith while critical race theory and transgenderism are promoted.

**That 's why I'm asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Referendum on Religious Liberty.** By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of the American people on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty--including religious liberty. Friend, you can complete the **National Referendum on Religious Liberty** by using the secure link below: [**https://lp.hillsdale.edu/religious-liberty-survey/**](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/VrtuC8SwkAtUXlo8Nktaeg~~/AARclAA~/RgRnyJewP0SxaHR0cHM6Ly9scC5oaWxsc2RhbGUuZWR1L3JlbGlnaW91cy1saWJlcnR5LXN1cnZleS8_c2M9MDEyNTNOMDI0MkwwQURPREVFUyZ1dG1fc291cmNlPXByb3NwZWN0aW5nJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPXJlbGlnaW91c2xpYmVydHlzdXJ2ZXkmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9UEEtUk9OLTIwMjQwMzA0VwNzcGNCCmXig__lZcezN0RSFGRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tWAQAAAAA) Like the founders of our nation, the founders of Hillsdale College understood the essential connection between faith and freedom. **The College was founded in 1844 to offer "sound learning" in order to preserve "the inestimable blessings...of civil and religious liberty."** Yet today's ruling class mocks people of faith as "backward," "bigots," and even "Christo-fascists." Politicians like Barack Obama claim that people like you "get bitter" and "cling to guns or religion." These so-called elites are full of contempt for you and for Christianity and will not protect your civil and religious liberties. You and I know that religious liberty in America is under serious threat. But we can reverse course. **The first step is ...EDUCATION.** Today's government policies that threaten religious liberty were conceived and implemented by people deceived by far-Left propaganda in our K-12 schools, colleges, and universities. That's why a vital part of this fight--in which Hillsdale College is a leader--is **reaching** and **teaching** millions of citizens the TRUTH about America's great heritage of religious liberty. We are heavily invested in our educational outreach efforts through our **Project to Save Religious Liberty in America.** These efforts include:
* **Teaching nearly 1,600 undergraduate and graduate students** --on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.--who bring their traditional faith with them as they join the fight to restore liberty and constitutional government in our country.

* **Distributing _Imprimis_** , America's leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.6 million homes and businesses ten times per year. Previous issues include "Inside the Transgender Empire" by Christopher F. Rufo, "The Most Important Decision in Life" by Bishop Robert Barron, and "The Politicization of the Department of Justice" by Harmeet K. Dhillon.

* **Producing and promoting free online courses** for any citizen who wishes to learn on topics such as Christianity, the Constitution, American history, and free market economics. Several courses (including "The Genesis Story: Reading Biblical Narratives," "Ancient Christianity," and "C.S. Lewis on Christianity") consider the important connection between faith and liberty.

* **Providing a classical K-12 curriculum** with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide.

After everything we've seen in recent years, the need for Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts is undeniable. So please share your views by completing the **National Referendum on Religious Liberty** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few moments of your time. Your completed survey will help us to develop the most effective strategy to **reach** and **teach** millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. As you might know, Hillsdale College refuses to accept ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. **This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations. Thanks to our generous donors, we remain true to our original mission, even as many other colleges and universities reject religious liberty and embrace radical and dangerous ideologies.** I hope you will partner with Hillsdale College by making a generous tax-deductible gift today. You can easily do so after completing the **National Referendum on Religious Liberty** , which you can access at this secure link: [**https://lp.hillsdale.edu/religious-liberty-survey/**](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/VrtuC8SwkAtUXlo8Nktaeg~~/AARclAA~/RgRnyJewP0SxaHR0cHM6Ly9scC5oaWxsc2RhbGUuZWR1L3JlbGlnaW91cy1saWJlcnR5LXN1cnZleS8_c2M9MDEyNTNOMDI0MkwwQURPREVFUyZ1dG1fc291cmNlPXByb3NwZWN0aW5nJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPXJlbGlnaW91c2xpYmVydHlzdXJ2ZXkmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9UEEtUk9OLTIwMjQwMzA0VwNzcGNCCmXig__lZcezN0RSFGRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tWAQAAAAA) Thank you for your support of Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts on behalf of religious liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844 |

| Restore Our Nation
---

body:

| |

| | [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zkn1g183lbcmc5mj8nkikvs5cgfb5vbs1fmqqt8g_rp22sh2s8i6eo34slge9or4cdh2bs)
---
Fellow American, Remember when gas prices were under $1.50 per gallon?Remember when there was peace in the Middle East and Europe and our allies and adversaries alike respected the United States?Remember when our southern border was secure, and law and order prevailed in our communities? _Now gas prices are at a 40-year high, the Ukraine has been turned into a warzone, and the crisis at our southern border is the worst it’s ever been. _But don’t be fooled... these things did not happen by accident.They’re a direct result of the Obama-Biden plot to destroy the Constitutional underpinnings of our country, to squash the States, and take over every aspect of our lives.And I’m afraid that if folks like you and me don’t immediately take action and stand up to them, America will be permanently weakened. **[That’s why I’m urgently asking you to join me and AMAC Action to save our country from being destroyed by today’s far-Left Democrats.](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zbnp57kj4gi2aogcji99r346vf772qem7eq1guk8_rp22sh2s8i6eo34slge9or4cdh2bs)** Fellow American, as you know we are not afraid of challenging Obama’s leftists plans for our country._We stood up to President Obama when he tried to socialize our healthcare system with “Obamacare” and “Medicare for All”..._ _We stood up to the Congressional Democrats’ repeated attempts to destroy Social Security and make it insolvent for our generation..._ _And now – with the slew of socialist policies flooding out of Washington D.C. – we’re standing up to the Obama-Biden led Democrat Party for trying to shred our Constitution._ Right now, our 75 AMAC Action chapters and 328 delegates are working hard to influence key members of Congress to vote on the issues that will make life easier for our 2.1+ million senior members and to protect our American values.And more than that, we’re in the trenches of state and local legislatures throughout the country to impact legislation that will prevent the radically liberal policies coming out of Washington D.C. from devastating our middle class.But that work is easier said than done. Because as a non-profit organization, everything we do to defend our traditional, conservative values is with the help of generous Americans like yourself. **[Will you help us fight for our America-first values in Congress with a one-time gift of $25, $50, $75, $100 or more to AMAC Action today?](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z3eaeq9rug7577jj4s8qi2mm597rku9m6ai44m08_rp22sh2s8i6eo34slge9or4cdh2bs)** Surely, America has seen her fair share of ups and downs, ebbs and flows._I saw it 40 years ago when I helped President Ronald Reagan bring our country back from Carter’s failed leadership – and I saw it a few years ago when I stood next to President Trump as he fought to bring our country back from Obama’s failed leadership._Obama and Joe Biden’s disastrous policies and actions have been causing:
---
| | • Record-high unemployment• Increased violent crime• Accelerating inflation • Runaway government spending to be supported by a monstrous and debilitating tax proposal• Fostering illegal immigration; drug smuggling; and human trafficking...
---
| | But that's not all.Behind the scenes, the Democrats are trying to fundamentally transform our Constitutional Republic into a socialist utopia by giving the federal government complete control over our state and local elections, weakening American strength at home and abroad, and helping Big Tech corporations censor anyone who does not share their far-Left world view. And if God-fearing, freedom-loving patriots like you and me do not take immediate action to fight for our beliefs, the country our grandchildren inherit will be radically different from that which we were so blessed to grow up in. **[So, can I count on you to help AMAC Action influence legislators to stop the Leftist Democrats’ unconstitutional power-grab with a gift of $25, $50, $75, $100 or more today?](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z0jgmvohfdp6laefq989dnr5oku1g2f0teekma5g_rp22sh2s8i6eo34slge9or4cdh2bs)** Thank for your generous support.
---
Sincerely,
---
Bob Carlstrom, PresidentAMAC Action

name: Trump Train News
subject: Justice, weaponized
body:
Please particpate in this survey on the Department of Justice.

This sponsored message from Trump Train News is on behalf of Hillsdale College

[](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zsj8cvffbbogahmfgiq3v0e5amd253rk9b408mho_rp22sh2s8i6eo34slge9or4cph2bs) Dear Fellow American, Before you move on to your next email—I would appreciate it if you would take a few moments to participate in Hillsdale College's **National Survey on the Department of Justice.** The survey will only take a few moments of your time, and its subject affects your liberty and the very survival of the rule of law in America. **The current administration's weaponization of the Department of Justice is unprecedented in American history.** Instead of protecting your God-given constitutional rights, the administration uses the Department of Justice to attack its political opponents... ...as well as Christians, parents, and anyone who dares to stand up for our constitutional liberties. At the same time, with the help of the media it...
* Covers up a two-tiered justice system that violates your constitutional rights

* Hides the corruption of the ruling class

* Attacks those with traditional viewpoints

**That's why I'm asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Survey on the Department of Justice.** By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans like you on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty—including the importance of the rule of law and checks and balances, which the American Founders saw as essential safeguards against corruption. Friend, you can complete the National Survey on the Department of Justice by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zopieu7pg763gii207kft02uohrjspe5k4uug418_rp22sh2s8i6eo34slge9or4cph2bs)** The **Declaration of Independence** argues that **the purpose of just government is to secure our natural rights** and that **just government is founded on the consent of the governed.** Yet today's ruling class regularly disregards the will of the American people, and our rights—to the freedoms of speech, assembly, and religion, to due process, to gun ownership, and more—are under constant attack. **You and I know that liberty in America is under serious threat. But as I travel around the country, I tell the audiences I speak to how we are engaging in the fight against this threat.** A vital part of our efforts in this fight—in which Hillsdale College is a leader—is **reaching** and **teaching** millions of citizens, with the TRUTH about America's great heritage of liberty. We are heavily invested in our educational outreach efforts through our **Project to Defend Liberty Nationwide by Reaching and Teaching Millions.** These efforts include:
* **Teaching bright and principled students** —on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.—who receive a rigorous, **classical liberal arts education, including** a required course on the Constitution

* **Distributing _Imprimis_** , America's leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.4 million homes and businesses ten times per year; previous issues include “The Politicization of the Department of Justice” by Harmeet K. Dhillon

* **Producing and promoting free online courses** for any citizen who wishes to learn, on topics such as the Constitution, American history, and free market economics

* **Providing a classical K-12 curriculum** with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide

After everything we've seen over the past few years, the need for Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts is undeniable. So please share your views by completing our **National Survey on the Department of Justice** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. Your completed survey will help us form the most effective strategy to **reach** and **teach** millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. As you might know, Hillsdale College is almost unique in American higher education in its refusal to accept EVEN ONE PENNY of government funding—not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. **This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations. But it also means that our work depends entirely on the generous support of private citizens, like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty.** If you agree that we are now seeing an unprecedented assault on the American way of life, I hope you will partner with Hillsdale College by making a generous tax-deductible gift today. You can easily do so after completing the attached **National Survey on the Department of Justice** , which you can access at this secure link: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zc8fn2hni5ajgifpbdlruoa6frm04d40m5kfc5no_rp22sh2s8i6eo34slge9or4cph2bs)** Thank you for your time and attention. I look forward to receiving your completed survey, and I sincerely appreciate your support of Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844 |
---

subject: Very real chance I lose tomorrow’s election
disclaimer_text: paid for by Adam Schiff himself
body:
Recent polls show Republican Steve Garvey surging ahead in our top-two, open-party primary
# [](https://act.katieporter.com/go/14558?t=1&akid=38687%2E3422442%2EcStUkH)
Derek,
Tomorrow, March 5th is Election Day—**and there is a very real chance we’re going to lose.**
Recent polls show Republican Steve Garvey surging ahead in our top-two, open-party primary—thanks to a more than $11 million ad campaign promoting Garvey, paid for by Adam Schiff himself.
I’m fighting for survival, but with less than 15% of ballots returned, we still have time to pull ahead and win this (because polls all agree, this race will be CLOSE). **_[Anything you can give right now will be put to immediate use reaching voters.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/kp4s-em-20240304-1?refcode=em20240304-38687&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&refcode2=38687_3422442_cStUkH&akid=38687%2E3422442%2EcStUkH)_**
**So in this final sprint, here’s my pitch to California voters:**
* **We need to shake up Washington, and unlike Adam Schiff, I’m not beholden to corporate special interests:** I’m the only person in this race who has never taken corporate PAC money and supports banning it altogether. And unlike my opponents, I reject federal lobbyist money and have never traded individual stocks while in office. I’ll always hold powerful industries and executives accountable—which is why a crypto-industry super PAC and a few billionaires are spending millions on ads attacking me.
* **California needs a warrior fighting for our top priorities—housing affordability and climate action:**
* As a consumer protection attorney who has spent years holding Big Banks accountable for cheating homeowners, I know my Housing for All plan will benefit renters and homeowners for generations to come.

The long, dark night of ultra-partisan gerrymandering is over, and a new day for democracy now dawns in the Badger State. **In late February, a new set of state legislative maps were signed into law for Wisconsin.** These maps are graded “A” for fairness by the head of the nonpartisan Princeton Gerrymandering Project. The current maps scored an F. With the stroke of a pen, Wisconsin went from a “democracy desert” to, well, a democracy. This was all possible because of you. The result was one of the most egregious, extreme partisan gerrymanders in American political history. In 2012 and 2018, Wisconsin voters overwhelmingly voted for Democratic majorities in the legislature but Republicans won huge majorities of the seats. In 2020 and 2022, Democrats won major statewide victories, but Republicans won near-supermajorities. All the while, Republican politicians in Wisconsin have used their power to restrict access to the ballot, remove authorities that voters had entrusted to statewide elected officials like the Governor and Attorney General, and smash the freedoms of workers to organize and advocate for themselves. _For thirteen years, the democracy-proof legislature has been laying siege to democracy itself. _ But those statewide victories added up. In 2018, 2020, and 2023, voters built a new progressive majority on the State Supreme Court. By electing Governor Evers and preventing GOP supermajorities, they stopped hard-right maps from being signed into law. And last year, a civic uprising prevented Republicans from impeaching Janet Protasiewicz. In December, the Supreme Court ruled that Wisconsin’s legislative maps were unconstitutional. This wasn’t easy. This team had to knock on doors, call phones, chip in, and share our views with friends and online—year after year, election after election, never giving up even when it felt like all was lost. _But we did it. _ **Today, the work doesn’t end. The candidate recruitment process now goes into overdrive. And at the same time, we remain vigilant in case Republican politicians in Madison and their allies once again, through the courts or any other strategy, attempt to thwart majority rule.** Today, we commit to doing the work, ending the malign speakership of Robin Vos, breaking the GOP supermajority in the State Senate, and paving the way towards a Democratic state Senate majority in 2026. Peter,
2023’s information crisis isn’t over. Last year, media organizations around the country cut more than 20,000 jobs due to downsizing and consolidations meant to protect news organizations’ bottom line. **And now, in 2024, layoffs and mergers are happening at twice the rate. Outlets impacted include legacy media powerhouses _CBS News_ , the _Los Angeles Times_ , and the _Baltimore Sun_.**
These layoffs have created even more news deserts nationwide, leaving many needing more factual, local news they can trust. Important stories go unreported, serious issues don’t get proper coverage, and right-wing online lies and conspiracies spread unchecked.
In an election year where the future of our democracy hangs on the outcome, COURIER is ready to meet this moment head-on.
**So here is the good news, Peter:**
While newsrooms around the country are closing, **COURIER is hiring more reporters to staff up our ten battleground newsrooms nationwide. **
That’s not all, thanks to the generosity and support of incredible grassroots donors like you, we’re even opening an eleventh newsroom in Texas later this year.

---
| Fellow Patriot,

I feel like our culture has forgotten--or ignored--some very important and basic lessons when it comes to the development of human life.

Our society has been infected by an anti-life ideology, treating its most vulnerable members as disposable objects. Abortion that was once thought of as a last resort in a medical emergency has become the new normal.

Medicine tells us that life begins at the moment of conception. It also tells us when an unborn baby develops a heartbeat, brainwaves, and nervous system. Yet, despite all of this, the unborn are not treated as though they are alive or even human. [](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=44e6b7a737fe4537bb1afee3e1008643&_e=gk5i5QOXQ83bs_2K7qaxEaKNTBlV78TLGodKMWPFCf48lkl7DocdXMz41CuM6GnioKI3FClrFoHwrPiYblyxPFghjfaHo0RkzdcEC6SFNjggbzMxkl4IK3zp2JnWCGA3T8xPeJ6RmXKxVoVsbpq7BsbJtyN11fFZqvVprKM38WmZbEn5-rnLS-e36l4T2uT2Mfpukawl3OUbk4TLY3Fc530oqyY6nXi4-KoElc7Pl19Bg1Xp17QoFeIfcFhi0O9_uXU9SN_r0QryCMv0f1WPKd3XIRn3rqVSsob3uM6LB1vpKmVPT-6RRo_ZwNOb5RfCE8oD0QTplLbR4vsQtJYu0z_KGaPVGcPrceu9-jWNRWp3jNLbkufP8dN_N7LvWUz8qZwWDMdBM5L9mW9l7865uQ%3D%3D) **
As a surgeon, I have operated on infants pre-birth. I can assure you that they are very much alive.**

Life is a precious gift that has been given to us from our creator. No person is disposable, and every life is precious according to Him.

I believe that everyone deserves life, even those who have been denied this right by our society. I believe that together we can make a difference and bring dignity and a voice to the unborn. I also believe that I'm not alone in this belief.

I believe that you believe that too.

I've started working with a group of like-minded individuals who are looking to change our culture. We want to build a society that values life but that takes people like you and I making a commitment.

The first step is clearly stating what we believe and what we are willing to do to protect the lives of the unborn. [**Will you join me today and stand up for those who cannot do it for themselves?**](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=44e6b7a737fe4537bb1afee3e1008643&_e=gk5i5QOXQ83bs_2K7qaxEaKNTBlV78TLGodKMWPFCf48lkl7DocdXMz41CuM6GnioKI3FClrFoHwrPiYblyxPFghjfaHo0RkzdcEC6SFNjggbzMxkl4IK3zp2JnWCGA3T8xPeJ6RmXKxVoVsbpq7BsbJtyN11fFZqvVprKM38WmZbEn5-rnLS-e36l4T2uT2Mfpukawl3OUbk4TLY3Fc530oqyY6nXi4-KoElc7Pl19Bg1Xp17QoFeIfcFhi0O9_AyGbR1B7yDAInrLCiU4-ZrmL-Vl_X0JursiEWYuY0SS7k0yK60BVAnt8vVkJYBwNm2v1jdxgkD3gBM55yefhjSaHCMhzF6ZnGgIFgFAJbbKChQZxHW32wuc0LFmSl2VVBhoQo7BEg_xOLMwU2PpGrQ%3D%3D)

I've created a new pro-life pledge; I'd love your support. Would you read the pledge below to see if you align with our shared goals and are willing to commit to fighting for the lives of the unborn?

[https://offers.americancornerstone.org/pro-life-statement/](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=44e6b7a737fe4537bb1afee3e1008643&_e=gk5i5QOXQ83bs_2K7qaxEaKNTBlV78TLGodKMWPFCf48lkl7DocdXMz41CuM6GnioKI3FClrFoHwrPiYblyxPFghjfaHo0RkzdcEC6SFNjggbzMxkl4IK3zp2JnWCGA3T8xPeJ6RmXKxVoVsbpq7BsbJtyN11fFZqvVprKM38WmZbEn5-rnLS-e36l4T2uT2Mfpukawl3OUbk4TLY3Fc530oqyY6nXi4-KoElc7Pl19Bg1Xp17QoFeIfcFhi0O9_WCXKQwb9DZm-VhiS8EfVnNqNsKKTFSsj26YJPJxmJtqIKkRBfWTZwl-gcP_DY-YlrDoJYDZNWqfT-uCARuictxZshNhdIxL8j3aSz5G-ifN_fUoyigO3MGUWMcBg-sxJ65ASSI_YNzAdqQXoeP2jFw%3D%3D)

Regards,

Dr. Ben Carson
Founder and Chairman
American Cornerstone Institute

You and I cannot let them get away with this. The top two vote getters on March 5th will advance to November. So, your support is absolutely critical to help me keep building the momentum needed to beat Adam Schiff and Katie Porter first in the primary and then again in November. **[That why I’m humbly asking you to rush and emergency $30 contribution to my campaign today.](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=f9ab168c89c84f95b2799d2442f3922f&_e=e8sg835G6Pk63cmxfH-tFYD8bBbhu08z0xQo0CiGgF9FPKTK3hVZf6FrivlaUCtHfL1b5m0Oav-7Zgix5hqRfrTN61oZVt4OZ-4g_3vwFk1nY3VOSkTnSa-O7TAGbr8CKEVdWvORlxkmrmIZ5RfRgNH7tncxcNZ-es6hXcze0p8QnmyRlmFKsWMLy9grSLPhslTdZsi-pfPwceDf636ORcnMjK9ZSa-I-RSJBhWeRXfMP1JD4yrsDyT0St87aCBrP48nxRUx77nXzVk4HXWIe2vyO1YHmhAVY8BE8sXwKRZCtSxPt8q-HMQwOnAxSAgr6vVaxffzt1qXwrsfeocSCbJQhIgiVF-uSaubCBc0QZcn2afZ_AOonYgZIgJulcrxK3rwL5tGV-MS_KzFfx2fog%3D%3D)** There is less than a week until the primary election. That’s it. Then, after that, you and I will have just eight months to build a 58-county, grassroots campaign capable of defeating Adam Schiff - with his _ActBlue_ allies and the war chest he's assembled during the two decades he spent in Washington, DC. There’s no time to lose. With every day that goes by, you and I are getting more and more reminders why it’s so important we win this election. The reality is present-day America is starting to look a lot like 1970s America. You remember what it was like:
---
| |
* Not only were gas prices sky high, Carter's rationing meant we could only buy gas on even or odd days depending on our license plate numbers. Remember?

* Eleven Israeli athletes were slaughtered at the Olympic Village in Munich by terrorists. Remember?

* Fifty-two Americans were held hostage for 444 days by terrorists in Iran. Remember??

---
| | Democrat policies had brought America to its knees. And now, as Yogi Berra used to say, **_"It's deja vu all over again."_** Joe Biden, Adam Schiff and the rest of the Democrats don't care one bit that Americans are having a hard time. I'd go even further to say they welcome the misery so they can keep folks down and dependent. You and I _must_ win this race. **[That’s why I’m humbly asking you to rush your $30 donation to my campaign today to give me the boost I need to win in the primary.](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=f9ab168c89c84f95b2799d2442f3922f&_e=e8sg835G6Pk63cmxfH-tFYD8bBbhu08z0xQo0CiGgF9FPKTK3hVZf6FrivlaUCtHfL1b5m0Oav-7Zgix5hqRfrTN61oZVt4OZ-4g_3vwFk1nY3VOSkTnSa-O7TAGbr8CKEVdWvORlxkmrmIZ5RfRgNH7tncxcNZ-es6hXcze0p8QnmyRlmFKsWMLy9grSLPhslTdZsi-pfPwceDf636ORcnMjK9ZSa-I-RSJBhWeRXfMP1JD4yrsDyT0St87aCBrhskRmhLZRogrnfoGACVHpsqmhCseaQ6iHYw0qSiuCbkRPxqGuXzKMiY0qRDvlIl4Emp0bQonSVhD4jy3DIx0kvs3Kff-3ketbD_ZuhhQOPSXTl0JiiN9DHE7VA8wefTnb1D6isudRw5mOlaIfpOESg%3D%3D)** Time is the most important factor. Trump Campaign Staff Introduction: “Mr. President, United States Senate candidate from Virginia, Scott Parkinson!”

**President Trump:** “Wow. United States Senate, that’s a big deal. How’s it looking?”

These were the introductory words spoken during my meeting with President Trump backstage in Richmond on Saturday before his BIG speech in front of thousands of Virginians. It was truly my honor to meet with President Trump and share a little about our campaign to defeat Tim Kaine in 2024.

I don’t ever misrepresent conversations and I want to make clear with each of you that I do not have President Trump’s endorsement... **but I’m going to continue to work hard to earn it.**

---

I have enthusiastically endorsed Donald J. Trump for President. President Trump represents the forgotten, disconnected American voter that is simply tired of career politicians and a government that picks winners and losers, rather than defends our freedoms and God-given rights. America will be safer, more prosperous, and more respected under the next four years of a Trump 2.0 presidency.

In order to win, we need to raise even more money. Campaign contributions are the fuel of a healthy campaign because it allows me to get my message out to Virginians. When we get our message out, we get more exposure. When we get more exposure, we raise more money. This is the cycle of a campaign that can win. Will you please help me?

Please consider a $100 contribution to help us get President Trump’s attention. This email will reach over 100,000 emails on my list. And I need each of you to chip in what you can to help me defeat Tim Kaine.

I want to remind you of some things we’ve seen (and lived through) in recent years—which we never thought we’d see in our country...

This sponsored message from Conservatives Give is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=778980969ecb4e7481c7195793eb638d&_e=eGcadJEyjTNe-4swRb5CHn13oo5uKlXCeuXY9ZQ5_1mI4dKg_vCf-srYAMlg7PJyVIY_nLtDQtKBPrSRhr8NOUaFlb3iWy9OYCeFJEj_dGaHoLi-pXqQc0wCyN_aO3_xJW8zLor1y57Gl0nXXoxPfIFuEyBqYoGDzZNCD3n_jZyFzt7lb6lf9zM396S18Z2XR1M629C0bL8ZGvd26WF3txScSGq8sVsmXht1uxb_3Rjf8AM-qjT7OXZC5HQDGUYkrKhbZBWJpy8XNNIha_ZxwUQczSIEG2RGLifj343Jhat-rf1vQ9hHWVImtzFo6XGYCSVWUADiRHEU0ra17IKIYbw0TbHm4XqaVRrO2g7RgfKhmudUkNKNcDW9Z4K6Toig512QIit7mZgyD_ffSAPuew%3D%3D) Dear Friend, You have been selected by Hillsdale College to represent your state in a **National Referendum on Religious Liberty.** The referendum will only take a few moments of your time. Before you complete it, I want to remind you of some things we've seen (and lived through) in recent years--which we never thought we'd see in our country...
* Government mandates forcing Christian churches to close while casinos, strip clubs, and drug dispensaries remained open.

* Far-Left activists targeting Christian business owners, Christian teachers, and Christian coaches through litigation.

* The weaponizing of the Department of Justice and the FBI against Christian pro-life advocates who are defined as believing in “extremist ideologies” and having the potential for “domestic terrorism.”

* Christians in the workplace being forced to hide their faith while critical race theory and transgenderism are promoted.

**That 's why I'm asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Referendum on Religious Liberty.** By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of the American people on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty--including religious liberty. Friend, you can complete the **National Referendum on Religious Liberty** by using the secure link below: [**https://lp.hillsdale.edu/religious-liberty-survey/**](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=778980969ecb4e7481c7195793eb638d&_e=eGcadJEyjTNe-4swRb5CHn13oo5uKlXCeuXY9ZQ5_1mI4dKg_vCf-srYAMlg7PJyVIY_nLtDQtKBPrSRhr8NOUaFlb3iWy9OYCeFJEj_dGaHoLi-pXqQc0wCyN_aO3_xJW8zLor1y57Gl0nXXoxPfIFuEyBqYoGDzZNCD3n_jZyFzt7lb6lf9zM396S18Z2XR1M629C0bL8ZGvd26WF3txScSGq8sVsmXht1uxb_3Rjf8AM-qjT7OXZC5HQDGUYki3g81VGwlqJgpRvAJgvh7EnFtC4VSCdcz3t1BavxJWFH4NsC6dmylxpCT8IdLsRNsyf0hv3ohl1UPZMocCsvh048qbeRaMQwo7ureVkSiFwkTMX8RBrPmDndqjh9aed9HmrpFV5LgJB7sbALhYwVTQ%3D%3D) Like the founders of our nation, the founders of Hillsdale College understood the essential connection between faith and freedom. **The College was founded in 1844 to offer "sound learning" in order to preserve "the inestimable blessings...of civil and religious liberty."** Yet today's ruling class mocks people of faith as "backward," "bigots," and even "Christo-fascists." Politicians like Barack Obama claim that people like you "get bitter" and "cling to guns or religion." These so-called elites are full of contempt for you and for Christianity and will not protect your civil and religious liberties. You and I know that religious liberty in America is under serious threat. But we can reverse course. **The first step is ...EDUCATION.** Today's government policies that threaten religious liberty were conceived and implemented by people deceived by far-Left propaganda in our K-12 schools, colleges, and universities. That's why a vital part of this fight--in which Hillsdale College is a leader--is **reaching** and **teaching** millions of citizens the TRUTH about America's great heritage of religious liberty. We are heavily invested in our educational outreach efforts through our **Project to Save Religious Liberty in America.** These efforts include:
* **Teaching nearly 1,600 undergraduate and graduate students** --on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.--who bring their traditional faith with them as they join the fight to restore liberty and constitutional government in our country.

* **Distributing _Imprimis_** , America's leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.6 million homes and businesses ten times per year. Previous issues include "Inside the Transgender Empire" by Christopher F. Rufo, "The Most Important Decision in Life" by Bishop Robert Barron, and "The Politicization of the Department of Justice" by Harmeet K. Dhillon.

* **Producing and promoting free online courses** for any citizen who wishes to learn on topics such as Christianity, the Constitution, American history, and free market economics. Several courses (including "The Genesis Story: Reading Biblical Narratives," "Ancient Christianity," and "C.S. Lewis on Christianity") consider the important connection between faith and liberty.

* **Providing a classical K-12 curriculum** with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide.

After everything we've seen in recent years, the need for Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts is undeniable. So please share your views by completing the **National Referendum on Religious Liberty** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few moments of your time. Your completed survey will help us to develop the most effective strategy to **reach** and **teach** millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. As you might know, Hillsdale College refuses to accept ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. **This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations. Thanks to our generous donors, we remain true to our original mission, even as many other colleges and universities reject religious liberty and embrace radical and dangerous ideologies.** I hope you will partner with Hillsdale College by making a generous tax-deductible gift today. You can easily do so after completing the **National Referendum on Religious Liberty** , which you can access at this secure link: [**https://lp.hillsdale.edu/religious-liberty-survey/**](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=778980969ecb4e7481c7195793eb638d&_e=eGcadJEyjTNe-4swRb5CHn13oo5uKlXCeuXY9ZQ5_1mI4dKg_vCf-srYAMlg7PJyVIY_nLtDQtKBPrSRhr8NOUaFlb3iWy9OYCeFJEj_dGaHoLi-pXqQc0wCyN_aO3_xJW8zLor1y57Gl0nXXoxPfIFuEyBqYoGDzZNCD3n_jZyFzt7lb6lf9zM396S18Z2XR1M629C0bL8ZGvd26WF3txScSGq8sVsmXht1uxb_3Rjf8AM-qjT7OXZC5HQDGUYkk6hXO99NfE-I3VpsU1080kDEVR8UfqmZVyQhCMqddwDYNKufXT0O1ptdw3u-6wO62pbms7tte3Bgy5f_iEDojpoO-fgOO43tMeZCIGKcn4pb67Y1dK-LXExMkj3DpAfdn4vw3AZEBOKtBODPAwI0Vw%3D%3D) Thank you for your support of Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts on behalf of religious liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844 |

However, we've built an incredible network of activists, volunteers, and supporters in Oregon and across the county — and it would be such a waste not to share some of the incredible people running for office on the same values you and I hold dear. **This month, I'd like to use my platform to help uplift other impactful candidates across Oregon, starting with my friend, Eddy Morales.** [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/80287123/458907549/-227105912?refcode=2024-03-04-moralesxpeterson&recurring=&amount=17&amounts=10,30,50,100,200&refcode2=c3ca4f6f-51da-ee11-85f9-002248223794&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84MzU0NSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjM2NhNGY2Zi01MWRhLWVlMTEtODVmOS0wMDIyNDgyMjM3OTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=xE6IWNiMUwkZBau_as0cN4Ye-eYmtEf3LI4G-uc0RfQ=) _I've been behind Eddy 100% — literally and figuratively — that's me applauding him as he approached the podium to announce his candidacy. _ Eddy's journey is incredibly inspiring. From learning the value of community at his mother's kitchen table full of neighbors in need of a good meal, to becoming a seasoned organizer and city councilor, he's dedicated his life to uplifting those around him. His experiences, from coordinating boycotts to advocating for underrepresented communities, have equipped him with the skills and insights needed to effect real change. His story resonates because his commitment to the work comes from a deep understanding of some of the worst problems plaguing our communities. **He knows firsthand what it's like to live in a frontline community experiencing a battery of climate crises; he's mourned the losses of siblings to gun violence and the opioid epidemic; and had his family torn apart by our senseless immigration policies.** Because of this firsthand experience, Eddy's work isn't just about rhetoric; it's about tangible results. Whether it's fighting for fair wages for farm workers, supporting immigrants, or spearheading initiatives for affordable housing and public safety, he has consistently demonstrated his commitment to improving lives and building a stronger, more inclusive community. **Now, as he sets his sights on Congress, Eddy is poised to bring his grassroots organizing approach to the national stage.** In a time of chaos and division and a moment when reproductive freedoms and LGBTQIA+ rights are under attack, Eddy's proven track record of bringing people together for the common good is exactly what we need. clean_body: We should talk about Eddy. | | | | Peter, As you know, I chose to suspend my campaign for Congress last month. However, we've built an incredible network of activists, volunteers, and supporters in Oregon and across the county — and it would be such a waste not to share some of the incredible people running for office on the same values you and I hold dear. This month, I'd like to use my platform to help uplift other impactful candidates across Oregon, starting with my friend, Eddy Morales. = I've been behind Eddy 100% — literally and figuratively — that's me applauding him as he approached the podium to announce his candidacy. Eddy's journey is incredibly inspiring. From learning the value of community at his mother's kitchen table full of neighbors in need of a good meal, to becoming a seasoned organizer and city councilor, he's dedicated his life to uplifting those around him. His experiences, from coordinating boycotts to advocating for underrepresented communities, have equipped him with the skills and insights needed to effect real change. His story resonates because his commitment to the work comes from a deep understanding of some of the worst problems plaguing our communities. He knows firsthand what it's like to live in a frontline community experiencing a battery of climate crises; he's mourned the losses of siblings to gun violence and the opioid epidemic; and had his family torn apart by our senseless immigration policies. Because of this firsthand experience, Eddy's work isn't just about rhetoric; it's about tangible results. Whether it's fighting for fair wages for farm workers, supporting immigrants, or spearheading initiatives for affordable housing and public safety, he has consistently demonstrated his commitment to improving lives and building a stronger, more inclusive community. Now, as he sets his sights on Congress, Eddy is poised to bring his grassroots organizing approach to the national stage. In a time of chaos and division and a moment when reproductive freedoms and LGBTQIA+ rights are under attack, Eddy's proven track record of bringing people together for the common good is exactly what we need. I believe that what's good for Oregon is good for the country, and Eddy Morales is the candidate who can deliver on that promise. = Donate Now If you've stored your info with ActBlue Express, we'll process your contribution instantly: | = | = ---|--- = | = = = I'm proud to endorse Eddy Morales for Congress, and I urge everyone who believes in progress and unity to join me in supporting his campaign. Together, we can ensure that our voices are heard in Washington, and that our communities have a champion fighting for them every step of the way. Tomorrow between campaigning, I will be doing a media tour, to discuss my thoughts on the State Committee races. Here is the schedule:
---
|
---
| We are dedicated to continue being your conservative team in the Republican State Committee. That's why the Establishment is working so hard to defeat us.
The Establishment, including Howie Carr, is openly supporting my opponent.
In case you didn't know, my opponent is a convicted felon. He was guilty of obstruction of justice and laundering drug money.

(The second was announcing I was running for Congress.) | [ ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/80287914/458910529/1655983737?refcode=EM_FL_EHA_20240304_fr_apacheresend_cand_mf_30da_xx_img&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85MzM5OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2YmFiOTk1Zi01M2RhLWVlMTEtODVmOS0wMDIyNDgyMjM3OTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Qy6Uhn-ykRe0rZ52Msm9XSYhINQmiTjWq2zhGabukwc=)
---
See, the Apache helicopters are basically airborne tanks. And our primary job as pilots was to provide cover for troops on the ground. So when I'd get the call to fly out, I'd race out to the Apache, put on my helmet, clip into my seat, and turn on the 48-foot rotor blades – all with the thought, **"I'm going to protect my people."**
And then off we'd fly.
That mentality, of being a protector, has never left me. And it's why I'm running for Congress – because I won't sit by when I see working families, veterans, women, LGBTQ+ folks, or anyone else who calls this country home being attacked.
**But this time, instead of jumping into an Apache helicopter to protect my people, I'm jumping into the race to represent Pennsylvania's First Congressional District.**
[ ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/80287915/458910530/1655983737?refcode=EM_FL_EHA_20240304_fr_apacheresend_cand_mf_30da_xx_img&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85MzM5OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2YmFiOTk1Zi01M2RhLWVlMTEtODVmOS0wMDIyNDgyMjM3OTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Qy6Uhn-ykRe0rZ52Msm9XSYhINQmiTjWq2zhGabukwc=)
---

subject: This week in Texas - March 4

body:
[1]Powered By People

Here’s what Powered by People is working on this week:

--------------------------------------------------------------------------

Voting in the Texas primaries

Early voting in the Texas primaries ended on Friday — and turnout so far
has been low. Election Day is tomorrow, March 5th, so please make a plan
to cast your ballot! [ https://act.betoorourke.com/go/59247?source=ema20240220-239478%3Fsource%3Dema20240304-239496&t=1001&akid=239496%2E444211%2EKmtwi_ ]Click here to learn what’s on your ballot and find
your polling place.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------

Supporting Texas wildfire victims

Texas continues to battle its largest wildfire on record. Covering over a
million acres, the fires have destroyed at least 500 homes and structures,
killed tens of thousands of livestock, and forced entire towns to
evacuate. At least two people have lost their lives. Here are a few ways
that you can help:

* Connect Community Services is providing food, hygiene items, clothing,
and housing support to those most in need. [ https://act.betoorourke.com/go/62835?source=ema20240304-239496&t=1002&akid=239496%2E444211%2EKmtwi_ ]Donate here.

* The Texas Farm Bureau’s Texas Panhandle Wildfire Relief Fund is
helping farmers and ranchers with unreimbursed agriculture losses.
[ https://act.betoorourke.com/go/62836?source=ema20240304-239496&t=1003&akid=239496%2E444211%2EKmtwi_ ]Donate here.

* The Texas Panhandle Volunteer Organizations Active in Disaster (VOAD)
is organizing volunteers for recovery efforts. [ https://act.betoorourke.com/go/62837?source=ema20240304-239496&t=1004&akid=239496%2E444211%2EKmtwi_ ]Sign up here.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------

Setting the record straight on immigration

Donald Trump and President Biden both came to the Texas border last week.
Their visits made it clearer than ever before that voters’ perceptions
about immigration may very well decide the results of the November
elections.

As Trump and Republicans anchor their campaigns on lies about immigrants,
we’re doing all we can to set the record straight about their
contributions to our country and to push for more legal, orderly pathways
for them to come here and add to our success.

[ https://act.betoorourke.com/go/62838?c0=pbp-em-20240304.JJ7oTH&refcode=ema20240304-239496&t=1005&akid=239496%2E444211%2EKmtwi_ ]Here’s why we should urge President Biden and our Democratic lawmakers
to do the same thing:

[ https://act.betoorourke.com/go/62838?c0=pbp-em-20240304.JJ7oTH&refcode=ema20240304-239496&t=1006&akid=239496%2E444211%2EKmtwi_ ][IMG]

[ https://act.betoorourke.com/go/62838?c0=pbp-em-20240304.JJ7oTH&refcode=ema20240304-239496&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1007&akid=239496%2E444211%2EKmtwi_ ]WATCH

--------------------------------------------------------------------------

Registering Texas voters

With so much at stake in these upcoming elections, Powered by People
volunteers spent the week knocking on doors and holding voter registration
drives in every part of the state. They’re bringing hundreds of thousands
of eligible but unregistered Democrats onto the rolls before the 2024
voter registration deadline.

[ https://act.betoorourke.com/go/62839?c0=pbp-em-20240304.cfoyHM&refcode=ema20240304-239496&t=1008&akid=239496%2E444211%2EKmtwi_ ][IMG]

[ https://act.betoorourke.com/go/62176?source=ema20240304-239496&t=1009&akid=239496%2E444211%2EKmtwi_ ]If you live in Texas, sign up to join this effort. Attend one of our
45-minute Volunteer Deputy Registrar (VDR) trainings over Zoom so you can
hit the ground running registering Texas voters.

[ https://act.betoorourke.com/go/62176?source=ema20240304-239496&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1010&akid=239496%2E444211%2EKmtwi_ ]SIGN UP

dollar goes toward recruiting more volunteers, registering more voters,
and helping Democratic candidates win elections up and down the ballot.

[ https://act.betoorourke.com/go/62839?c0=pbp-em-20240304.cfoyHM&refcode=ema20240304-239496&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1030&akid=239496%2E444211%2EKmtwi_ ]CONTRIBUTE

Supporting Texas wildfire victims Texas continues to battle its largest wildfire on record. Covering over a million acres, the fires have destroyed at least 500 homes and structures, killed tens of thousands of livestock, and forced entire towns to evacuate. At least two people have lost their lives. Here are a few ways that you can help: Connect Community Services is providing food, hygiene items, clothing, and housing support to those most in need. [ ]Donate here. The Texas Farm Bureau’s Texas Panhandle Wildfire Relief Fund is helping farmers and ranchers with unreimbursed agriculture losses. [ ]Donate here. * The Texas Panhandle Volunteer Organizations Active in Disaster (VOAD) is organizing volunteers for recovery efforts. [ ]Sign up here. Setting the record straight on immigration Donald Trump and President Biden both came to the Texas border last week. Their visits made it clearer than ever before that voters’ perceptions about immigration may very well decide the results of the November elections. As Trump and Republicans anchor their campaigns on lies about immigrants, we’re doing all we can to set the record straight about their contributions to our country and to push for more legal, orderly pathways for them to come here and add to our success. [ ]Here’s why we should urge President Biden and our Democratic lawmakers to do the same thing: [ ][IMG] [ ]WATCH Registering Texas voters With so much at stake in these upcoming elections, Powered by People volunteers spent the week knocking on doors and holding voter registration drives in every part of the state. They’re bringing hundreds of thousands of eligible but unregistered Democrats onto the rolls before the 2024 voter registration deadline. [ ][IMG] [ ]If you live in Texas, sign up to join this effort. Attend one of our 45-minute Volunteer Deputy Registrar (VDR) trainings over Zoom so you can hit the ground running registering Texas voters. [ ]SIGN UP [ ]Otherwise, I hope you’ll consider making a contribution today. Every dollar goes toward recruiting more volunteers, registering more voters, and helping Democratic candidates win elections up and down the ballot. [ ]CONTRIBUTE I hope it’s a great week for you. Beto

subject: How important is religious liberty to you?
body:
I want to remind you of some things we’ve seen (and lived through) in recent years—which we never thought we’d see in our country...

This sponsored message from Defend the Constitution is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=0701dcb84d7b48e8bfd3a255867aafa7&_e=cDtHNdJiDPmkRzVfD7QuJUng10zqzDvNVD7YpWhu_rCNP3YSk_t2O_7SkBNaiWKWWihXoSeWo-qy981-hp0a0ezrLXG2bZjY6QCiNbyDo_IkOmCuOiUPDICjrfUqItO1Dl4oYZxrKDBPCrgc3uac-JK-71xcs5cidL_v8BV-ESB7c1PsABb4BeAheMNK81jqhxd_N5_J6PudQFThGHHm_MNsJFFn88J1G-0EW0NqwUdkLCvhpU6HrI49VUbpdjEKimnsa5ClQePyXEOWXIfRB99rSOnQ0bY6ushsT2s0xiBiSLTMiVGJ67uU0EJfaLdK-epwUcCosW7G3TXwmpOPc-R38q9pAgt8tA0Jtpi5AttRG2TWSjHkbHdnI8zeoeK4yZ8siTMv_AzP3ZWAcZhCJQ%3D%3D) Dear Friend, You have been selected by Hillsdale College to represent your state in a **National Referendum on Religious Liberty.** The referendum will only take a few moments of your time. Before you complete it, I want to remind you of some things we've seen (and lived through) in recent years--which we never thought we'd see in our country...
* Government mandates forcing Christian churches to close while casinos, strip clubs, and drug dispensaries remained open.

* Far-Left activists targeting Christian business owners, Christian teachers, and Christian coaches through litigation.

* The weaponizing of the Department of Justice and the FBI against Christian pro-life advocates who are defined as believing in “extremist ideologies” and having the potential for “domestic terrorism.”

* Christians in the workplace being forced to hide their faith while critical race theory and transgenderism are promoted.

**That 's why I'm asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Referendum on Religious Liberty.** By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of the American people on this critical issue. body:
The cost of buying the 2024 election — so far.
# [](https://act.hillharper.com/go/421?t=1&akid=1042%2E62735%2EhwTv2D)
**“Outside groups have dumped nearly $318 million into 2024...elections” — more than six times the amount spent through the same period in 2020.**
\- _The Hill_
* * *
Want to know how much it costs to buy an election, Peter? This cycle, ehhhhh...that’ll just cost you a modest **$318 million!!!** 😡😡😡
That’s how much deep-pocketed special interest groups — like Big Pharma and the NRA — have spent so far this election cycle. _And the problem is only going to get worse._
Why? **Because we have a broken campaign finance system propped up by bought-and-paid-for politicians who REFUSE to end _Citizens United_ and get money out of politics.**
Now, THIS is the status quo for our “leaders” in Washington:
1. **Meet with constituents** in the morning and promise you’re their top priority
2. **Meet with deep-pocketed, special-interest lobbyists** later that same day

Constitution of Virginia

## Article I. Bill of Rights
## Section 13. Militia; standing armies; military subordinate to civil power

That a well regulated militia, composed of the body of the people, trained to arms, is the proper, natural, and safe defense of a free state, therefore, the right of the people to keep and bear arms shall not be infringed; that standing armies, in time of peace, should be avoided as dangerous to liberty; and that in all cases the military should be under strict subordination to, and governed by, the civil power.

subject: Friend, No Budget, No Pay for Congress is Common Sense.
body:
If you send me to Congress, I will actively support the No Budget, No Pay Act. This is common sense legislation that will incentivize Congress to do the job their damn job.
| | |
---
| [](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001LkRqbgsOcVUTJUaOYJm2b6VGidCo0Hz4bH_jJsu85VlXqDZWbWYU7OZ4I2JVAunte1m913s8JykbBx4uDPPgnjdY-KqscEwAjZ-BSFd4D7pqYVH9RFihgU10NiiLPIckLg51lNAwlkx8XQkRd39c3_o-7Lq9_NyV&c=UEWFvYzCU7tzHkVAqveA50zcVjBGVu83eqZuBCfsU5dpHwK9Awg8SQ==&ch=q8AVHLosv3s92VM1UlDL8ynNOTwNX5JceQPv6KsAsSU72PLJpHybBw==)
---
|
Friend
If you don't do your job, you don't get paid. Why should Congress?
Last week the House and Senate passed yet another continuing resolution to kick the can down the road and avoid doing the job we elected them to do.
West Michigan taxpayers who are forced to watch the constant cycle of government shutdowns and out of control government spending must be universally disappointed by the way their government is run. There's plenty of blame to go around for both parties.

| As unbelievable as it must be to West Michigan taxpayers who send a significant share of their money to Washington every year, the U.S. budget has only had a surplus five times in the last 50 years.
