name: David Hogg
subject: Peter, can I have a moment of your time to read an important note from the heart?
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY LEADERS WE DESERVE, LEADERSWEDESERVE
body:
Hey Peter, can I get a moment of your time today for something important?
# [](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/852?refcode=em20240304-1&t=1&akid=436%2E587540%2E4kvXfa)
Hey Peter – thanks for opening my email. I know there’s a lot going on, so I appreciate it. It’s a little long, but it’s from the heart, and it’s important.
**You don’t have to be obsessed with politics or watching the news 24/7 to know our country is in a bad place.** Horrific violence in the Middle East. A Republican Party that has gone so far off the rails they could barely elect a Speaker (multiple times). The leading Republican candidate for president is Donald Trump! And then we have unspeakable atrocities like mass shootings happening nearly every day because our “leaders” refuse to act. And many people talk about how Trump is a major threat to democracy and he is — but I believe there is an _even greater_ and _more long-term threat_ \- **hopelessness**.
When I was knocking doors for Leaders We Deserve-endorsed candidate Nadarius Clark for the Virginia elections last year, the most concerning answer I got when I asked if people were voting was “No, I don’t believe in voting” or “No, all politics is corrupt and my vote doesn’t matter.” This scares me because things can never get better if we continue electing people who say “government doesn't work” who then get elected and make it not work.
I’m deeply worried about us. And it’s not because I’m anti-America. It’s because I love this country and I desperately want to see us do better.
**We’re not going to fix this mess overnight. But we do have a plan.** A group of us launched Leaders We Deserve last summer. We started it because we know that young progressive leaders can change the future of this country for the better by giving us what we need most to get through this moment of democratic backsliding, HOPE. We can elect more young leaders like Nadarius Clark, but we can ONLY do it if enough of us get behind them.
For us to give the school shooting generation the hope it needs to secure the future of our democracy and build a more perfect union we must get to work electing the next generation of morally just leaders who put kids first and the NRA out of business.
**The truth is that young progressive candidates who are running for office face huge barriers.** The average age of our elected officials is astronomical. That’s because our election system favors those who are older, wealthy, and white. In 2020, Millennial and Gen-Z individuals only held 21% of State Legislative seats despite representing 45% of the electorate.
**We launched Leaders We Deserve specifically to coalesce support from millions of Americans who believe in the promise of this younger generation.**
Here's our plan:
* Find young progressives who are willing to run for Congress and state legislatures.
* Equip their campaigns with messaging, scheduling, and budget tools they need to win.
* And most importantly, raise funds from our massive national network (hey, that’s you!) to allow them to go toe-to-toe with their opponents and WIN.

**Peter, if we succeed, then ten years from now we’ll have shifted the politics of this nation dramatically.** Young, progressive leaders will make up their fair share of the legislative and congressional seats, allowing us to right the ship and build the future we deserve.
**But what we do _right now_ will determine whether or not that vision comes to pass.** We can’t just muddle along raising a couple hundred thousand dollars here and there. We’ll actually have to raise tens of millions of dollars from grassroots donors like you in order to get the breadth and scale we need to win in all corners of the country.
* * *
**Here’s what I need from you for our plan to work.**
– If you are blessed with the financial ability to make a really big donation (like $500 or more), please do so right now to help us make this vision a reality. [**Click here if you are fortunate enough to give $500 or more.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lwd-em-20240304-1?refcode=em20240304-1&amount=500&refcode2=436_587540_4kvXfa&akid=436%2E587540%2E4kvXfa)
– If you can give a small donation each month, that makes a big impact too. [**Click here if you think you can commit to a $25 monthly donation (or something like that).**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lwd-em-20240304-1?refcode=em20240304-1&amount=25&recurring=true&refcode2=436_587540_4kvXfa&akid=436%2E587540%2E4kvXfa)
– If you can’t give big and you can’t give monthly, that’s totally OK (most people can’t). [**Click here to just give a one time donation of whatever you can afford.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lwd-em-20240304-1?refcode=em20240304-1&amount=5&refcode2=436_587540_4kvXfa&akid=436%2E587540%2E4kvXfa)
– Last but not least, if you can’t chip in at all, I completely understand. All I ask is that you forward this email to three friends who might be aligned with our cause.
* * *
**I hope this fundraiser is as successful as I know it can be. I hope that we look back at this moment in ten years and say THIS is when everything started to change.**
If you have any questions at all about Leaders We Deserve, please check out our website or get in touch with us on social media.
Thank you from the bottom of my heart for reading today.
\- David Hogg

body:
VOTE RYAN MACKENZIE APRIL 23rd

Fellow American,

This week #TeamMackenzie was excited to launch our Veterans for Mackenzie coalition.

As state representative, I have been proud to help our veterans with regular office hours where we can dedicate time to focus on their particular needs. We have done this for many years - and helped some veterans with very difficult cases - and I will continue this if elected to Congress.

I am also proud to have authored legislation known as Startups for Soldiers several years ago. This program helps veterans as they transition to the private sector by waiving new business filing fees. Each year, this program is utilized by thousands of veterans across Pennsylvania.

In 2017, I was recognized for this work by the U.S. Department of Defense and they shared their “grateful appreciation to Representative Mackenzie for his leadership on public policy changes positively impacting the quality of life of Service members and their families residing in Pennsylvania.”

As congressman, I plan to do even more to help our veterans and I am honored to have the support of veterans in each county in PA-7 who share my America First policy vision for our country. Air Force veteran Joe Steber is heading the Veterans for Mackenzie coalition, and we had some great outreach to other veterans in Carbon County this past weekend.

Thank you to all our veterans for their service!

Thank you again to everyone who is working so hard to help us get America back on the right track!

Here are some other highlights from the week:

* Campaigning in Carbon County
* Northampton County Gun Show
* Upcoming Meet and Greet with Ryan Mackenzie
* Pictures Around PA-7

All the Best,

-Ryan Mackenzie

Campaigning in Carbon County

Friday, I campaigned in Carbon County stopping at 3 events. I was honored to be joined by local veterans as we talked about America First policies that help our military and protect our nation.

Northampton County Gun Show

I stopped at the Plainfield Township Volunteer Fire Company Gun Show on Saturday and talked to local sportsmen and gun owners about how I will do everything in my power to defend the 2nd Amendment.

Upcoming Meet and Greet with Ryan Mackenzie

Please join Ryan Mackenzie, State Rep. Ann Flood, and Portland Mayor Heather Fischer for a meet and greet as they talk about the local issues in the area.

PICTURES AROUND PA-7

Here are pictures from just some of the events I was so lucky to attend across the 7th District this week.

#TeamMackenzie and I continue to work hard every single day as we head toward the Primary on April 23rd, and then straight to the General Election in November! That's because the anti-Trump Media... Young radicals on college campuses... the holier-than-thou elites in Hollywood... Democrat Super PACs... Joe Biden's army of megadonors... They are fully committed to destroying our movement and replacing EVERY LAST ONE OF US with a Liberal Democrat.
